0GF725HRpIVwMd2f.name: 机械化进阶型战争机器
0GF725HRpIVwMd2f.publicNotes:
“热熔巨兽”是一款设计用于在战场上最大化杀戮与破坏的战争机器——它体型庞大、凶猛强悍。

The incursion began with a series of probes detected by anacites on Aballon. Strange machines with blazing sensors and articulated tentacles appeared out of nowhere, ripping through infrastructure seemingly at random and collecting intelligence all around Pact Worlds space. Panic spread fast, but since the machines always vanished without a trace, or exploded when captured, the sightings couldn't be confirmed or identified. Rumors began to circulate that the machines were a form of biotech never encountered before. Soon the Stewards became formally involved, shuttering the incidents behind the adamantine partition of top security clearance.

In Sarenith of 325 ag, after dozens of military operations failed to engage the elusive probes, a wing of fighters dispatched from the Idari finally got lucky and disabled one of the machines before it could self-destruct. Coaxed into giving up some of its secrets by top Pact Worlds scientists, the biotech vessel became the prototype for the "home grown" remote war machines that are currently being tested for use in combat. The replicas aren't alive but are built using robotic construction templates since the core of the original biotech design has proven too complicated to reverse engineer with Pact technology.

Remote war machines are proxies that can be controlled from a great distance. The original biotech war machines connect to the pilot's mind through a psychic link or unknown radio frequency. Robotic remote war machines connect to a computer via data link, allowing the pilot to control their proxy using a keyboard, virtual reality rig, or even a vidgame controller.

In battle, Hellknights are orderly, unrelenting, and deadly.

2DMxWPhGQfZQot2k.name: 刻法克虫
2DMxWPhGQfZQot2k.publicNotes:
初次遭遇刻法克虫的探险者往往感到惊讶——不仅因为其攻击性，更因其攻击目标：护甲与其他装备。在刻法克虫的领地，缺乏经验的探险者勘探归来时字面意义上两手空空的情况并不罕见，这常被本地人当作趣谈。

Khefak Biogenetics bioengineered khefaks to consume scrap thasteron so the waste could be refined into starship fuel. These creatures eventually became a prime example of a solution becoming a problem of its own. After the discovery of Drift travel, Akiton's thasteron market plummeted, removing the need for mining infrastructure, including khefaks. Khefak Biogenetics destroyed the production facilities, thinking they'd completely eradicated their creations. Khefaks are hardy, however, and the few survivors left the facilities. Beyond thasteron, they subsisted on inorganic materials, and their rapid reproduction rate allowed them to quickly spread all over Akiton. Some stowed away on starships, allowing them to spread throughout the Pact Worlds.

2DtTG1VJ5KPM83Wu.name: 接生圣者利贝罗巴
2DtTG1VJ5KPM83Wu.publicNotes:
利贝罗巴接生了新诞者。众多肢体从这个生物畸形的解剖结构上长出，每一条末端都是血淋淋的奥克腾岩剪刀。

Thirteen mortal Midwives attended the Newborn's birth and were transformed into eldritch beings by the nascent outer god's awakening. A Midwife always regenerates an identical new form so long as even a single speck of aucturnite—the name for the frozen chunks of planetcenta that once surrounded the Newborn—exists on this plane.

There are 13 types of Midwives, but their true numbers are unknown. Whether their names come from the mortal servants whose souls were the kindling for the Midwives' creation or have some other significance to the Newborn, also remains a mystery.

Each Midwife identifies themself by how they cared for the Newborn: if they swaddled, fed, carried, held, watched, warded, blessed, or performed other acts of nurturing for the outer god. The Midwives are powerful beings capable of transdimensional travel. They might be encountered in liminal spaces, such as the Drift or the Ghost Levels of Absalom Station, or they might be found among the clouds of aucturnite debris in the Gelid Edge. Their incomprehensible actions always advance the Newborn's inscrutable agenda—or their own.

The most well-known encounter the Pact Worlds have had with the Midwives took place in the immediate aftermath of the Newborn's birth. Amnieka, who swaddled the Newborn and has a hood of writhing tentacles around their visage, attacked Absalom Station directly, causing a massive power surge that threatened the lives of everyone on board. Chaos ensued, but a group of adventurers—who happened to be in the right elevator at the right time—found themselves in the station's Ghost Levels, where they thwarted Amnieka and prevented the Midwife from draining the station's reactors. The Midwives haven't acted so directly since that incident, but many suspect it's only a matter of time, and no one knows just how powerful the others might be.

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

大失败该生物受到两倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一束熵射线，迅速且无差别地分解物质。进行远程法术攻击对抗目标的AC。如果命中，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；或者如果目标生物有科技特征，则会受到2d6持续性酸蚀伤害并陷入故障1。如果重击，伤害翻倍，并且如果目标生物有科技特征，则陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

升阶 （+1）增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应的方式与一个生物分享痛苦的感觉。目标受到3d12精神伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环）该法术最多可瞄准四个生物，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力凝聚为一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值，或者如果你和一个至少有12点生命值的活力网络建立纽带，则可以从活力网络中扣除12点生命值。尝试一次远程法术攻击对抗目标AC。在命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。如果重击，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你可以用大量的精神信息或神圣审判使一个生物的精神超负荷。心灵冲击会造成2d6心灵伤害。在重击时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 音波尖啸
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a painfully rapid cone of vibrations by letting out a cathartic scream, dealing 1d8 sonic damage to creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage by 1d8.
items.description:
你发出一声宣泄性的痛苦尖啸，释放锥形的振动波，对区域内的生物造成1d8音波伤害，这具有基础强韧豁免。豁免失败的生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d8

items.name: 返回奥克腾
items.expectedDescription: Presulea teleports to the location of any aucturnite fragment within a planetary range. Presulea automatically uses this ability as a free action when reduced to 0 Hit Points as long as a piece of aucturnite is within range, reforming their body and recovering completely over the next 24 hours.
items.description: （传送） 利贝罗巴传送至行星距离内任意有奥克腾岩的位置。如果利贝罗巴降至0生命值，它以自由动作自动使用此能力，并且只要奥克腾岩处于范围内，它就能在24小时候重构其身体并完全恢复。

2PVFsdaTR9mTfCid.name: 死链尸妖
2PVFsdaTR9mTfCid.publicNotes: 双眼空洞的死链尸妖是一类死于过度沉迷社交媒体之人化作的不死生物，它们游荡于现实与虚拟世界，渴求着互动与存在感。在他们眼中，所有生者全都是潜在的关注者，仅此而已。死链尸妖追猎那些涉足科技的人，妄图将他们变成痴迷的粉丝。他们不断用精简的魔法科技代码发出哀嚎，仿佛在对着某个早已被人遗忘的网络辩论尖叫，试图通过经由超自然配置过的内容覆写设备进而吸引他人的注意力。然而一旦他们的受害者被死链上，这些新晋的死链尸妖便会失去兴趣，被同样的黑暗死灵算法驱使。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 已匹配的通讯单元
items.expectedDescription: The comm unit of a necrolinked wight can be disabled for 1 hour with a successful DC 15 check to Disable a Device or Disable a System. A necrolinked wight with a disabled comm unit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, gains a +6 bonus to Perception, and can't Check its Feed.
items.description: 死链尸妖的通讯单元可以在成功通过DC 15的解除装置或解除系统（Disable a System）后禁用1小时。通讯单元被禁用的死链尸妖处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}，察觉检定获得+6加值，且无法使用检查信息流能力。

items.name: 社交媒体成瘾
items.expectedDescription: The necrolinked wight is driven by a desire to continue their cycles of spiteful hatred and media consumption on the infosphere. They spend their first action of each round to Check Feed. Eternally obsessed, a necrolinked wight will always try to stay within range of an active infosphere signal. A necrolinked wight with no infosphere access or perceived threats functions as if their aligned comm unit was disabled and does whatever it can to regain infosphere access.
items.description: （神术）死链尸妖渴望在信息圈重复恶毒恨意和信息消费的永恒循环。受着欲望驱使，他们每轮第一个行动永远是使用检查信息流能力。屈服于永恒的痴迷，死链尸妖永远会试图呆在信息圈信号活跃的范围内。无法访问信息圈或是没有感知到威胁的死链尸妖会如同他们的通讯单元被禁用了一般行动，并会尽其所能地重新访问信息圈。

2lUmJOYTvroP2Yas.name: 瑞瓦林兽终灵
2lUmJOYTvroP2Yas.publicNotes:
瑞瓦林兽是毛茸茸的，长着扁齿，三眼的四足草食动物，在寒冷的德斯塔隆二号（Destalon-2）上被封建社会作为驮兽饲养。瑞瓦林兽与其初生的社会一同被烬蛛族灭绝。据传烬蛛族随后便逃离了该星球，据称是因为遭遇了长着锯齿状獠牙，凶恶红眼的幽灵巨兽袭击。

Every species follows a natural arc as it emerges and evolves: rising, thriving, declining, and falling into extinction. When extremely unnatural ends to these paths occur—when unexpected predation, industrialization, or alien pathogens wipe out a population—endlings are born. These spectral members of extinct species typically develop as "answers" to their eradication. Xenobiologists differ on what creates endlings, unable to confirm whether the creatures are a species' last collective sorrow made manifest or just vengeful individual spirits—the last lights to go out.

items.name: 战争视觉
items.expectedDescription: A rivarin endling can sense the presence of bleeding, frightened, or wounded creatures as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 瑞瓦林兽终灵能在所列范围内以精确感官感知到处于流血，惊惧或受伤状态的生物的存在。

2oGp04TzbcaiLlOa.name: 活化科技护甲
2oGp04TzbcaiLlOa.publicNotes:
活化的科技护甲套装堪称忠诚的护卫、理想的训练假人或可靠的安全防线。

Objects can be animated in multiple ways for a variety of functions. Since ancient times, weapons and armor have been given life as guardians and sentries through magic or ritual.

items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

2yV2zP6CiddspRxM.name: 尸骸舰队军官
2yV2zP6CiddspRxM.publicNotes:
尸骸舰队军官是胆识过人的战斗领袖，能增强其不死盟友，并受训以消灭生者。

The Corpse Fleet is an army made up of undead supremacists who refuse to bow to the will of the living. Founded by defectors from the Eoxian navy, the Corpse Fleet aims to shatter Pact Worlds unity and liberate Eox from the influence of the living and those bone sages who sided with them. Unyielding and utterly ruthless, the Corpse Fleet deals in death and destruction, feeding on the living and exploiting the dead.

items.name: 屠戮生灵
items.expectedDescription: The Corpse Fleet officer has trained to decimate the living. Their Strikes deal an additional 1d6 void damage.
items.description: 尸骸舰队军官受训于屠戮生者。它的打击造成额外1d6虚能伤害（包含至上文打击数据中）。

items.name: 不倦狂怒
items.expectedDescription: The Corpse Fleet officer makes one ranged Strike and one melee Strike in any order. These attacks count toward their multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks are made.
items.description: 尸骸舰队军官以任意顺序进行一次远程打击和一次近战打击。这些攻击记入其多重攻击减值，但直到两次攻击均完成减值才会增加。

34uf5wsM7LwBxhmw.name: 羚豹
34uf5wsM7LwBxhmw.publicNotes:
羚豹需要 3年才能达到成年体型。随着每年成长，它们的犄角会愈发壮观，有些个体的犄角长度甚至能超过 15尺。

Those traveling through Akiton's Winterlands risk stumbling on its apex predator: the carnivorous arabuk.

3ZxpWhscwtELicqD.name: 经理魔（执照魔鬼）
3ZxpWhscwtELicqD.publicNotes:
经理魔是经纪人、商业谈判专家和战争投机者。他们活跃于马尔法涅（Malfane）诸城与水行星恩布罗伊（Embroi），并日益频繁地出席近宇的企业法务会议。这些魔鬼精通谈判、工商管理及上百种文化中的企业术语，在为公司提供竞争优势的同时，也为自身建立声誉。地狱的知识与工业力量对许多谋求压制竞争对手的企业极具诱惑力，而经理魔也极乐于提供协助。企业以在产品中植入间谍软件、在服务条款中添加魔鬼条款为代价，换取使用地狱知识产权的机会，并将这些地狱式臃肿软件转嫁给客户。有传言称，经理魔会尽可能助推初创企业的频繁更迭，暗中破坏任何试图突破或绕开魔鬼协议条款的公司。

In the shadows of space stations, halls of courtrooms, and offices of corporations, devils tempt mortals with promises of power and lay the groundwork for their conquest. A devil's pacts can vary from elaborate contracts to quick promises, but they all end the same way: a mortal soul condemned, and Hell's forces bolstered. From the open rule of Malfane, the unseen control of Embroi, and hidden pacts with souls across the galaxy, devils continue their relentless work to spread tyranny and force the universe to resemble the hellish bureaucracy of their home.

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标耳边响起蕴含星辰之外不可名状奥秘的不祥之音，使其神智混乱。目标需要尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功目标听到了诡异的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}，持续1轮。

失败目标开始漫无目的地游荡，使用每个动作来快步（方向随机）。当其移动时，其会采取最安全的路线并且不会进入有害地形。法术会持续1分钟或者直到目标被敌对动作瞄准。

大失败类似失败，除了目标还会语无伦次地喋喋不休。任何在其20尺内开始回合的生物也需要尝试一次意志豁免。在失败时，这些生物也需要在下回合开始时花费第一个动作来进行快步（随机方向），随后临时免疫此法术24小时。这是一个失能效果。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你可以用魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕和其他显示器（包括护甲上的通讯单元）上播报可怕的消息。区域内能看到一个或多个显示屏的生物必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物因显示内容@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

失败该生物因显示内迷魂并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}（即使迷魂结束）。

大失败该生物因显示内迷魂，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 3}，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 Doomed 1}（即使迷魂结束）。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你可以用大量的精神信息或神圣审判使一个生物的精神超负荷。心灵冲击会造成2d6心灵伤害。在重击时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你可以用大量的精神信息或神圣审判使一个生物的精神超负荷。心灵冲击会造成2d6心灵伤害。在重击时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 炼狱追踪
items.expectedDescription: For as long as a creature is taking persistent bleed damage from the wahtunshna's claw Strike, that creature can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by the wahtunshna.
items.description: 只要某个生物因经理魔的爪打击而持续受到持续流血伤害，该生物便无法对经理魔保持@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]状态。

items.name: 运动感知
items.expectedDescription: A quyu can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 枯狳能在所列范围内以精确感官通过空气或水中因生物移动产生的震动感知附近生物。

4Ne5pnML3LV9xYYU.name: 变形怪
4Ne5pnML3LV9xYYU.publicNotes:
变形怪，在泥怪中尤为独特，在许多协约世界的家庭中备受珍视。这些温顺可亲的生物在绝大多数情况下都无害，能迅速适应家庭生活，易于训练，似乎乐于通过令人喜爱或滑稽的变形取悦主人。在生命周期后期，这些生物会毫无预兆地一分为二进行繁殖。饲主们观察到，每只新生变形怪都需要重新学习原体掌握的各种技巧，这促使研究者推断，原始个体在繁殖过程中已然消亡。

Oozes of many types lurk in dark and abandoned places across the galaxy, emerging only to satiate their appetites and threaten adventurers, explorers, and hapless workers alike.

items.name: 拟态物体
items.expectedDescription: A proog can spend 1 minute altering its appearance to imitate any solid object of 1 Bulk or less, though it can't duplicate moving parts or specialized functions. A mimicking proog gains a +2 Circumstance bonus to Deception checks to conceal its true nature. Touching the proog negates this bonus.
items.description: 变形怪可以花费1分钟将自身外表变为模仿任何不高于1负载的固态物体，不过它不能复制活动部件或特定功能。处于拟态状态的变形怪在隐蔽自己真身的欺骗检定上获得+2环境加值。触摸变形怪将无视此加值。

4WTe8VPGlVdQxx6Y.name: 机械化卓越型战争机器
4WTe8VPGlVdQxx6Y.publicNotes:
代号“音波虾”的战争机器由工程师团队基于卡洛-马霍伊（Kalo-Mahoi）原型机研发，是一款专精水下作战的机器人战争机器。与它两栖特性的创造者一样，音波虾在陆地环境中同样表现卓越。

The incursion began with a series of probes detected by anacites on Aballon. Strange machines with blazing sensors and articulated tentacles appeared out of nowhere, ripping through infrastructure seemingly at random and collecting intelligence all around Pact Worlds space. Panic spread fast, but since the machines always vanished without a trace, or exploded when captured, the sightings couldn't be confirmed or identified. Rumors began to circulate that the machines were a form of biotech never encountered before. Soon the Stewards became formally involved, shuttering the incidents behind the adamantine partition of top security clearance.

In Sarenith of 325 ag, after dozens of military operations failed to engage the elusive probes, a wing of fighters dispatched from the Idari finally got lucky and disabled one of the machines before it could self-destruct. Coaxed into giving up some of its secrets by top Pact Worlds scientists, the biotech vessel became the prototype for the "home grown" remote war machines that are currently being tested for use in combat. The replicas aren't alive but are built using robotic construction templates since the core of the original biotech design has proven too complicated to reverse engineer with Pact technology.

Remote war machines are proxies that can be controlled from a great distance. The original biotech war machines connect to the pilot's mind through a psychic link or unknown radio frequency. Robotic remote war machines connect to a computer via data link, allowing the pilot to control their proxy using a keyboard, virtual reality rig, or even a vidgame controller.

items.name: 星际通讯
items.expectedDescription: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.
items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

items.name: 水下武装
items.expectedDescription: The superior war machine's ranged Strikes are launched with such high velocity that they can be used underwater without penalty.
items.description: 该战争机器的远程打击以极高速度发射，在水下使用时不会受到任何减值。

4oGJJFXVdCDA7oFL.name: 烬蛛族血战者
4oGJJFXVdCDA7oFL.publicNotes:
血战者是指那些在烬蛛族神权国麾下经历过至少六场战斗而幸存下来的烬蛛族。他们在其他烬蛛族组成的部队中担任低级指挥官，或是作为精英狙击手和突击队员。血战者常常选择不参与他们认为“有失身份”的战斗，除非需要作为增援介入，否则他们更愿意在远处训练士兵或观战。这些烬蛛族通常会利用额外的训练时间，学习如何在战斗中识别出关键敌人。

Jinsuls are a warlike species scattered across the Vast. Six-legged creatures with a bulbous body covered in eyes, jinsuls have notable segments of chitin along with a set of upper forelimbs for using equipment. They long ago lived in the region of space known as the Scoured Stars but eventually departed and settled on the harsh world of Rax. In recent years, the divine herald Dhurus unified the jinsuls into a cohesive force known as the Jinsul Hierocracy, which briefly retook the Scoured Stars. A joint alliance between several species and members of the Starfinder Society defeated Dhurus and scattered the jinsuls back into the Vast.

With countless bases and fleets operating in deep space, jinsuls mostly act as raiders, scavenging for equipment and testing their mettle against other species. Indoctrinated to view themselves as a superior species, with only other inhabitants of the Scoured Stars having any value, jinsuls prefer to engage in short-ranged combat with their foes.

Jinsuls aren't numerous enough to fill every need on the many ships and starbases they control across the galaxy. Instead, they rely on robots and automated computer systems (always commanded by at least one jinsul officer) to keep their space stations running efficiently. These systems are programmed to be just as deadly and ruthless as jinsuls themselves; even the most innocuous automated system or robot, like a garbage collector, might wield deadly weapons or contain vicious technomagical countermeasures.

items.name: 瞄准
items.expectedDescription: The jinsul aims with their melee or ranged weapon against a target within 60 feet. For the rest of their turn, successful Strikes made with that weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the target's cover bonus to AC by 1.
items.description: 烬蛛族以60尺范围内的一个目标为对象，使用近战或远程武器进行瞄准。在其回合剩余时间中，使用该武器成功打击目标时，将额外造成1d4点精准伤害，并将目标从掩蔽中获得的AC加值降低1。

4qkyqWbZ9BsXP3pL.name: 核泊精
4qkyqWbZ9BsXP3pL.publicNotes: 这些核能妖精栖息于反应堆中，体现着其辐射家园瞬息万变的本质。他们随情绪变幻色彩，这种特性有时能预示其危险的倦怠发作。核泊精从无恶意，却鲜少考量自身行为的后果。

items.name: 刺激细胞
items.expectedDescription:
You vitalize and stimulate the target at a cellular level, giving it a temporary burst of energy that unfortunately takes an exhausting toll. The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action to Stride or Strike. After that round ends, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until it can rest for 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.
items.description:
你从细胞层面激发目标的活力，使其获得短暂的能量爆发，但不幸的是，这将使其精疲力竭。目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]状态，并可以使用额外的行动行走或打击。该轮结束后，目标会变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]，直到休息10分钟。

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.

items.name: 辐射感知
items.expectedDescription: A hesper can sense radiation sources, such as reactors and power cores, as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 核泊精能够感知到辐射源，例如飞船的动力核心或反应堆，作为一种在所列范围内的模糊感官。

items.name: 能量射线
items.expectedDescription: A hesper can change the damage type of its energy ray as a free action.
items.description: 核泊精可以用自由动作改变其能量射线的伤害类型。

52WVLSR7qq73zQ98.name: 自由船长无赖
52WVLSR7qq73zQ98.publicNotes:
自由船长们对雇员并不挑剔，会接纳几乎所有他们认为能遵守海盗法典的人。每艘自由船长的船只每次航行都会招募几名新人，其中有些人甚至会再次随船出航。虽然这些水手通常被安排做船上最卑贱、最琐碎的工作，但一旦战斗打响，他们就会抓住每个机会向其他船员证明自己的价值。

The Free Captains have been a scourge of interstellar shipping across the Pact Worlds for generations, but since the adoption of Drift Lanes, the outlaws have expanded their reach and scale by targeting ships across the galaxy using the new standardized interstellar shipping routes.

items.name: 利用恐惧
items.expectedDescription: Any creature that has the frightened condition is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the Free Captain knave's attacks.
items.description: 任何处于惊惧状态的生物对自由船长无赖的攻击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

items.name: 电感应
items.expectedDescription: While in space, the shipbreaker can sense electronic signals from starships in the same star system. While it can't necessarily interpret starship signals, it has a vague sense of the intent or purpose of any given starship signal, such as "to scan," "to communicate," or "to warn of danger."
items.description: 在太空中时，碎舰者能感知同一恒星系内星舰发出的电子信号。虽然它不一定能解读星舰信号的具体内容，但能模糊感知到任何给定星舰信号的意图或目的，例如“扫描”、“通讯”或“危险警告”。

items.name: 科技感知
items.expectedDescription: A shipbreaker can detect creatures and items with the tech trait as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 碎舰者能以模糊感官，感知到所列范围内的带有科技特征的生物和物品。

items.name: 火箭冲撞
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a rocket of flame from behind you and blast forward. You move in a straight line up to twice your Speed; you can move through spaces occupied by creatures, and the movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures in the area take 6d12 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 persistent fire damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. You reappear at the end of the line.

Heightened (+2) The fire damage increases by 2d12, and the persistent fire damage on a critical failure increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你向身后火箭喷射，极速向前冲刺。你直线移动两倍于你速度的距离，你可以穿过被生物占据的空间，并且这一移动不会触发反应。在区域内的生物受到6d12火焰伤害，这具有一次基础反射豁免。在大失败时，该生物还会额外受到2d6持续火焰伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1轮。你将重新出现在直线的终点。

升阶（+2）火焰伤害增加2d12，豁免大失败的持续火焰伤害增加1d6。

66tw46IKra4XaN0w.name: 电光炫灵
66tw46IKra4XaN0w.publicNotes:
电光炫灵是一群脾气暴躁、色彩鲜艳的风元素生物。自霓虹灯发明后，它们在宇宙中便越来越常见。它们以危险的光爆与色爆形式现身，能直接瘫痪城市电网，并将电力转化为闪烁的霓虹万花筒。它们常化身为当地传说中神鸟或其他神话生物的形态。有些追求新潮的夜店老板曾尝试驾驭电光炫灵为舞会制造特效，但结果往往是满场舞客狼狈躲避等离子射线的场面。“等离子滑步”（plasma slide）是一种排舞的名称，它的走红源于一起事件：在伊奥克斯星上有一家以狂野派对闻名的通宵俱乐部“霓虹墓穴”（Neon Crypt），当时一只电光炫灵在那里失控逃脱，这种舞蹈随即爆红网络。

Elementals are energetic intrusions from the primal planes of existence. They take many forms, from mindless eddies in the wind or water to complex entities capable of wielding primal magic. The advent of space travel and the progress of technology have allowed even more living embodiments of the elements to manifest in the Universe.

Natural events like wildfires, solar storms, and floods can unleash hordes of unruly elementals on a planet or into a region of space. Sometimes, a gathering of powerful elementals causes a natural disaster on an epic scale, like an off-the-charts solar flare that fries a planet's power grid or a ceaseless storm swirling in a gas giant's atmosphere.

items.name: 微光浸染
items.expectedDescription: A plasmazer emits bright light of their color in a 30-foot radius and dim light in the next 30 feet.
items.description: 电光炫灵会散发其对应色彩的明亮光芒，在30尺半径内产生明亮光照，在接下来的30尺内产生昏暗光照。

6HgCFAlJv7fYs8sm.name: 幼年相位兽
6HgCFAlJv7fYs8sm.publicNotes:
尽管年纪尚小，幼年相位兽仍是危险而可怕的掠食者。

Incredibly ferocious, nyssholoras are dinosaur-like creatures that number among the most dangerous and feared apex predators on the planet of Castrovel. These walking weapons brandish lethal biology: a massive maw lined with twin rows of razor-sharp teeth, scythe-shaped phasic blade forearms that vibrate at ultrasonic speeds, and a scourge-like tail capable of absorbing electricity from the surrounding atmosphere. Yet, nyssholoras are also cunning and perceptive—a frill of tentacles that crowns their head detect telepathic signals, making it impossible for the local formians and lashuntas to escape their notice. Their phasic blades can cut through walls and vehicles as easily as underbrush, ensuring prey have nowhere safe to hide.

items.name: 相位打击
items.expectedDescription: A nyssholora's phasic blade Strike treats any object or construct it hits as if the target had half as much Hardness as usual.
items.description: 相位兽的相位刃打击将被其命中的任何物体或构装体视作硬度比通常情况减半。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 牧者之触
items.expectedDescription: An erabryth's Strikes have the benefit of a ghost killer upgrade and deal an extra 1d4 void damage to living creatures or 1d4 vitality damage to undead.
items.description: 招魂者的打击具有灭鬼强化模块的增益，对活物造成额外1d4虚能伤害，或对不死生物造成额外1d4命能伤害。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Developing far out in the Vast from an insectile species known as kucharns, the Swarm is considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of myriad component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and the Swarm's pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in its reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, its assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm is the direct ancestor of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space.

items.name: 恐噩辐射
items.expectedDescription: 120 feet. The Terror spreads radiation everywhere it goes. Non-creature plants near the Terror quickly wither and die. Any creature that begins its turn within the aura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} and is exposed to terrible radiation sickness each round.
items.description: （灵光，疾病，毒素，辐射） 120尺。恐噩会在所过每处散播辐射。靠近恐噩的非生物植物迅速枯萎死亡。任何在灵光范围内开始回合的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 3}并每轮承受恐噩辐射病。

items.name: 剧毒之触
items.expectedDescription: Creatures struck by the Terror's sludge tendril gain weakness 10 to poison and take a –2 status penalty to Fortitude saves for 1 round.
items.description: 被恐噩的污泥触须打击的生物获得对毒素的弱点10以及强韧豁免上-2状态减值，持续1轮。

items.name: 水体感知
items.expectedDescription: A cyanoscum can sense the presence of water within 60 feet as an imprecise sense.
items.description: 蓝藻灵能以模糊感官，感知60尺范围内的水体存在。

items.name: 剧毒弥漫
items.expectedDescription: Creatures inside the cyanoscum bloom's space are exposed to cyanoscum toxin. A creature can't reduce the poison below stage 1 while it shares a space with the cyanoscum bloom.
items.description: 位于蓝藻灵水华占据空间内的生物，会持续暴露在其毒素之中。只要该生物仍与蓝藻灵水华处于同一空间，其所中毒素的阶段便无法被降低至阶段1以下。

items.name: 柔软躯体
items.expectedDescription: A cyanoscum bloom can Squeeze through spaces that aren't airtight at half its Speed per round.
items.description: 蓝藻灵每轮能以自身速度的一半挤入任何非完全封闭的狭窄空间。

C6pSZ3ievLcTTOkj.name: 稀金塑命者
C6pSZ3ievLcTTOkj.publicNotes: 稀金塑命者是由经过提纯的稀金（具有预知特性的稀有星金）制作而成的强大魔法构装体。凭借着预见未来并对其作出反应的能力，稀金塑命者成为了卓越的守卫和令人畏惧的敌人。

items.name: 窥见命运
items.expectedDescription: A finitrium fatebender gains a +5 circumstance bonus when rolling Perception for initiative, as it acts on flashes of insight harvested from potential futures.
items.description: 稀金塑命者在为了决定先攻而投掷察觉时，会获得+5点环境加值，因为它能根据从潜在未来中获取的一闪而过的洞见来行动。

items.name: 掠食隐形
items.expectedDescription: The glass serpent is naturally invisible. When a glass serpent takes a hostile action of any kind, it is hidden instead of undetected until the start of its next turn, as parts of its body become momentarily tangible. A glass serpent that has swallowed a creature becomes visible for the next day as its meal is being digested. If the swallowed creature escapes or is otherwise removed, the glass serpent immediately returns to being invisible.
items.description: 玻璃蛇天生隐形。当玻璃蛇使用任何类型的敌对动作时，它会变为藏匿不再无踪，直到其下个回合开始，因为它身体的一部分会瞬间变得有形。活吞下生物的玻璃蛇在第二天消化食物前都会变得可见。如果被吞下的生物逃脱或被其他方式移除，玻璃蛇会立即恢复隐形。

CdNumfS6YHCQXnrg.name: 云魟
CdNumfS6YHCQXnrg.publicNotes: 巨大的云魟是类似布雷瑟达和利亚瓦拉这种气态巨行星上的顶级掠食者。它们拥有惊人的机动性，能以无可匹敌的速度飞过大气层中，使得它们在狩猎时无可逃脱。

items.name: 震慑鞭打
items.expectedDescription: A creature that takes electricity damage from a cloud ray's tail Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} on a critical hit), then becomes temporarily immune to stunning lash for 1 minute. Creatures with a weakness to electricity don't become temporarily immune.
items.description: （电击） 因云魟尾打击而受到电击伤害的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}（重击时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 2}），然后临时免疫震慑鞭打1分钟。具有电击弱点的生物不会变为临时免疫。

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检查时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.

DXFU7ZmEZzHWC0Np.name: 湮灭级刺客机器人
DXFU7ZmEZzHWC0Np.publicNotes:
湮灭级刺客机器人优雅而致命，依靠他们的隐秘场让敌人难辨虚实，在最出其不意的时机发动致命一击。其先进的智能系统不仅能策划更复杂的伏击，还能根据局势变化灵活应变，并响应客户的定制需求——这意味着，它们可以根据任务意图与传达的信息，将刺杀执行得或隐秘至极，或惨烈异常。

In some societies, machines automate many processes. It only makes sense, then, that some would attempt to automate the act of murder. Most manufacturers would never admit to creating such designs, forcing wealthy figures to go through hidden channels to acquire units from secret facilities or unscrupulous manufacturers. Regardless of their origins, these robots can be programmed with a target and set loose, the owner assured that either their target will be dead or will be unable to prove who tried to kill them thanks to the unit's fried circuitry.

items.name: 自毁协议
items.expectedDescription: The circuitry of an assassin robot self-destructs upon the robot's destruction, making tracing its owner extremely difficult. Add 10 to the DC of a Computers check to recover data from a destroyed assassin robot.
items.description: 当刺客机器人被摧毁时，其电路系统将自动触发自毁程序，这使得追踪其所有者变得极其困难。从被摧毁的刺客机器人中恢复数据时，计算机检定的DC需额外增加10点。

Db64i0oL1biUoViM.name: 沙鲼
Db64i0oL1biUoViM.publicNotes: 致命的隐秘掠食者，沙鲼潜伏在物质宇宙各处沙漠世界的地表之下。尽管平均翼展达10尺，体重达1吨，但凭借鹅卵石般沙色的外皮，它们在原生栖息地几乎难以被察觉。它们如光线穿透水体般感知周遭震动，在沙滩与沙丘间滑行伏击不幸的猎物。其锋利的螫针注入能分解血肉骨骼的致命毒素，将猎物溶解成沙粒，这样滤食性的沙鲼便能从悬浮的沙粒中筛选出食物颗粒。

DdHenlm0aHbcYEXc.name: 愤怒陨星魂
DdHenlm0aHbcYEXc.publicNotes:
随着折磨持续多年，陨星魂的愤怒与日俱增。

When a solarian perishes while out of sync with the cycle of stars, their soul might become entangled with their solar mote. Extreme cosmic forces act on the soul as it attempts to reach the River of Souls, stretching it infinitely thin for all of eternity.

items.name: 引力冲击
items.expectedDescription: A creature critically hit by an enraged noquasar's graviton flare is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target is flying, it falls up to 30 feet.
items.description: 被愤怒陨星魂的引力子耀斑重击的生物会受击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。若目标正在飞行，则坠落至多30尺。

items.name: 科技感知
items.expectedDescription: An assembly ooze can detect creatures and objects with the tech trait as a precise sense within the listed range.
items.description: 组装泥怪能在所列范围内以精确感官侦测到具有科技特征的生物和物体。

ELlaiydZLahpmfas.publicNotes:
监视级安保机器人被编程执行小范围巡逻任务，其功能类似看门狗，但配备内置武器。部分制造商将这类机器人设计成犬类形态，而它们具备的飞行能力常令那些以为只会遭遇地面防御的潜在窃贼大吃一惊。

Security robots are ubiquitous throughout industrialized space and have major presences in both the Pact Worlds and Veskarium, employed and customized by corporations and private citizens alike.

While most soldier robot models are built to be as destructive as possible, and elimination robots are designed to kill, security robots usually have fail-safes programmed into their behavior to prevent them from causing any more violence than is necessary to perform their designated security function. This makes them especially useful in cities, where unintended destruction might harm bystanders or cause legal issues, and even on starships, where a stray laser blast might cause serious damage to vital starship systems.

items.name: 重力场
items.expectedDescription:
Bending the laws of the Universe to your will, you increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying and Climbing creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).
items.description:
你扭曲宇宙法则，增强一个区域内的重力。区域内所有飞行生物下降40尺。整个区域对飞行生物和攀爬生物来说是高等困难地形，对地面生物来说是困难地形。任何被重力场拉到地面上的生物都会受到钝击伤害，如同坠落一样。

该区域内的重力增加一级（例如，零重力变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，高重力变为极端重力）。

items.name: 闪电枷锁
items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.expectedDescription: You alter gravity's effects on you. You treat gravity as if it were your choice of one step higher or lower (for example, if you were in an area of low gravity, you could choose either standard gravity or zero-g). While the spell is active, you reduce the distance of any forced movement that would affect you by 5 feet (minimum 0 feet), and you ignore being clumsy and untethered because of gravity effects on you. You can Dismiss the spell.
items.description: 你可以改变重力对你的影响。你可以选择将重力提升或降低一级（例如，如果你身处低重力的区域，你可以选择标准重力或零重力）。当该法术起效时，你降低任何影响你的强制移动的距离5尺（最小0尺），而且你不会因为重力的影响而变得笨拙和失重untethered。你可以解消该法术。

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 感应应答
items.expectedDescription: While on their bonded celestial body, a nymph can sense approaching starships within a day's travel from the celestial body. This doesn't give them any information about the ship, its occupants, or its exact position. The nymph can send a message to the ship as if using a personal comm unit.
items.description: 当宁芙处于与其绑定的天体上时，她能感应到距离天体一天航程范围内的接近的星舰。这不会给她提供关于星舰、其乘员或其确切位置的任何信息。宁芙可以像使用个人通讯单元一样向星舰发送信息。

Ej0wWqICzaYDBiHr.name: 地狱骑士扈从
Ej0wWqICzaYDBiHr.publicNotes:
地狱骑士扈从是最低阶的地狱骑士，但要获得这个位阶也需要他们作为学徒服役6年，然后通过地狱骑士试炼，此期间他们必须召唤，战斗，并击败一只地狱的魔族。

Hellknights are infernal knights, and while they once ruled entire nations on Lost Golarion, the Hellknights of the Pact Worlds enforce law and order more holistically, traveling in massive citadel starships to spread their influence rather than remaining in any one place. In battle, Hellknights are orderly, unrelenting, and deadly.

items.name: 战术型破片手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d4[bleed]]

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 2d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击 @Damage[1d4[bleed]]

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 2d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.

items.name: 战术型爆燃手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 2d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:10]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击击退5尺

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 2d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:10]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.

items.name: 四臂
items.expectedDescription: You have four arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
items.description: （卡萨斯人）

F6GauwVhEtddvyqj.name: 噬冠兽死灵植入丧尸
F6GauwVhEtddvyqj.publicNotes:
死灵植入丧尸被由不死生物的身体部件和内脏制成的死灵植入活化。在伊奥克斯，用死灵植入物植入动物和魔兽，以确保它们在这颗死亡星球上存活的做法十分常见。在死后，这些生物多数会复苏为真正的不死生物，继续为其制作者效力。

Technological zombies are created when a dead creature is reanimated (or otherwise kept moving) by an internal or integrated technological item—usually an augmentation. Despite the vast differences in form and hardware between different tech zombies, they do have similarities—they're mindless undead driven to harm the living, with technological components and weaknesses that can be leveraged.

items.name: 乱石行者
items.expectedDescription: The crest-eater necrograft zombie ignores difficult terrain caused by rubble, sand, and uneven ground made of earth and stone.
items.description: 噬冠兽死灵植入丧尸忽视由碎石、沙地及由土石构成的不稳地面所形成的困难地形。

items.name: 阵列协同
items.expectedDescription: When a line-class soldier robot is adjacent to at least two other allies, the robot gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 for Reflex saves against area effects.
items.description: 当线列级士兵机器人至少和两名其他盟友相邻时，它的AC和豁免有+1环境加值。针对区域效果的反射豁免时，该加值提升至+2。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙之外，不可名状的力量，对区域内所有生物造成3d12心灵伤害，如同幻影尖爪、啃咬或是触须击中每个目标。区域中的每个生物都需要尝试一次意志豁免。区域对每个因该法术效果陷入恶心的生物都视为困难地形。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

大失败该生物受到两倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 全息记忆
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the target's mind, extract a specific memory you have some awareness of, and project it into a hologram. Alternatively, when casting this spell, you can choose to pull a random memory left to the GM's discretion. The holographic memory can be no longer than 5 minutes; if the extracted memory is longer than this, the hologram simply ends at that point. The hologram includes audio as well as visual components, but it doesn't contain haptic, olfactory, or other components. The hologram typically plays a memory that takes place in a single scene, though it can cut to multiple scenes if they're accurate to the memory and its length allows. The hologram plays the memory exactly as the target experienced it and from the target's perspective, so it often lacks context.

This spell can target any living, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or deceased sentient creature with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher. If the target is deceased, it can't have been dead for longer than 1 week, or this spell fails; once a corpse has been subjected to holographic memory by any caster, any subsequent castings of holographic memory fail.

If the target is unwilling to share this memory, it can attempt a Will save to resist this spell.

如果目标非自愿分享记忆，其可以尝试一次意志豁免来对抗此法术。

items.name: 分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应的方式与一个生物分享痛苦的感觉。目标受到3d12精神伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环）该法术最多可瞄准四个生物，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你可以用魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕和其他显示器（包括护甲上的通讯单元）上播报可怕的消息。区域内能看到一个或多个显示屏的生物必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物因显示内容@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

失败该生物因显示内迷魂并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}（即使迷魂结束）。

大失败该生物因显示内迷魂，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 3}，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 Doomed 1}（即使迷魂结束）。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力凝聚为一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值，或者如果你和一个至少有12点生命值的活力网络建立纽带，则可以从活力网络中扣除12点生命值。尝试一次远程法术攻击对抗目标AC。在命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。如果重击，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 回旋弹
items.expectedDescription:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一道由闪烁钢铁构成的旋转圆盘或光滑球体在目标之间弹射跃动。造成2d4钝击或挥砍伤害，需要进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 圣洁武装
items.expectedDescription: In the hands of a barachius angel, all weapons gain the holy and magical traits and are powered by divine will, negating the need for batteries or ammunition.
items.description: 圣裁天使持用的所有武器皆获得圣洁特征与魔法特征，并由神圣意志驱动，无需电池或弹药。

G8VrBK6T9Kbe8Sjf.name: 辐照不死冲锋者
G8VrBK6T9Kbe8Sjf.publicNotes:
冲锋者，其称呼与其起源星球一样多，通常是由自然或人为核灾难杀死的野兽的辐照尸体产生。这些四足的动物不死生物因其强大的冲锋攻击而得名。

To survive in the unforgiving expanse of space, creatures must be naturally adapted or take protective measures. While the dead rarely need such precautions against these threats, sometimes radiation can animate a corpse (or several) to a state of undeath!

Scientists and religious scholars alike debate whether a specific type of radiation is to blame for this phenomenon that spontaneously triggers unlife, but all agree on the dangers such irradiated creatures pose. Many types of radiation could be the cause: intense bursts of cosmic radiation emitted by the stars, magically enhanced radioactive isotopes found in a planet's or moon's crust, or even the advent of new energy sources in a society (or its radioactive waste) contaminating the land. Regardless of their specific origin, irradiated undead all pose the same threat—they emit ionizing radiation that ravages everything around them.

items.name: 红外视觉
items.expectedDescription: A bloodbrother can detect infrared radiation (such as that given off by warm-blooded creatures) as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 血亲兽能在所列范围以精确感官侦测到红外辐射（例如温血动物发出的）。

items.name: 冰面穿行
items.expectedDescription: A bloodbrother ignores difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.
items.description: 血亲兽忽略由冰和雪形成的困难地形，也不会在穿越冰面时有摔倒的风险。

GYDhEJCi5SWrolvK.name: 悖论接触者
GYDhEJCi5SWrolvK.publicNotes:
六次记录案例里，与悖论17长期接触的个体事后持续表现出异常行为。其中两人坚称自己在做梦，四人则认为置身于敌对模拟环境。后者中有一人在接受访谈时执意要“再次寻找光芒”，随后径直穿过看守人员与拘留室墙壁消失，至今下落不明。

Can you ever really know that the Universe you perceive exists? That you'll never awaken one day to find it was all a dream? A planet full of philosophers sought the answers to these questions once upon a time… shortly before they all vanished en masse. They left behind confusing records stating that the light of a "whirling star" revealed that physical matter had no substance and the Universe was secretly a mental prison. These records are all that remain from the first known encounter with the being known as Paradox 17.

items.name: 微灵盟友
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.
items.description:
你召唤一只小小的活跃微灵，能够分散意志最坚定的战斗人员的注意。微灵在你目标周围悬浮游弋。微灵没有占据空间，不会提供夹击，也没有其他生物会具有的属性。微灵能在10尺半径内产生明亮光照。当你施放该法术以及每次你维持该法术时，微灵试图分散目标的注意力。该目标必须通过意志豁免，否则在你下一回合开始前将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。豁免大成功的生物将对微灵盟友临时免疫1小时。

升阶（+1）你在施法时创造出额外一只微灵，这允许你选择一个额外目标。你创造的每个微灵都必须有不同的目标，并且当你维持该法术时，它们会同时分散各自目标的注意力。

items.name: 先进型闪光手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round

A flash grenade unleashes a blast of bright light that requires creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10] to attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 2 rounds.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1轮

闪光手雷会释放出一阵刺眼的光芒，要求@Template[burst|distance:10]范围内的生物进行@Check[fortitude|against:class]豁免。豁免失败时，该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]2轮。

items.name: 感知虚妄
items.expectedDescription: The solipsist treats all creatures, objects, and structures they're observing (except for Paradox 17) as quasi-illusory, allowing the solipsist to move through them as though the solipsist were incorporeal. They can also choose to use Will for any saving throw against any non-damaging effect.
items.description: 接触者将所有其可见的生物，物体和构造物（除了悖论17）视作准幻象，允许接触者能移动穿越它们，如同接触者是虚体一般。他也能够在对抗任何非伤害效果时，使用意志豁免替代任何豁免。

Gs2LvB3eXWTuUiNv.name: 沙地蠕虫先兆者
Gs2LvB3eXWTuUiNv.publicNotes:
古老的流散带沙地蠕虫会成为蠕虫殖民的典范——它们征服小行星，并不辞辛劳地对其进行宜居性改造，以支撑蠕虫社会的存续。

"Space worm" is a nonscientific term for a xenobiologically complex clade of invertebrate animals and beasts that make their home in the vastness of space. Some, like the diaspora and dust worms, show signs of intelligence and are directly related to each other. Others, like the surnoch, evolved separately, with their origins completely unknown to science.

items.name: 电场通讯
items.expectedDescription: Dust worm augurs communicate by shaping and reading electromagnetic fields. This functions like telepathy with creatures that share this ability.
items.description: 沙地蠕虫通过塑造与读取电磁场进行交流。对于同样拥有此能力的生物而言，这种交流方式类似心灵感应。

items.name: 电磁视觉
items.expectedDescription: Dust worm aurgurs sense their surroundings by reading electromagnetic fields, including disruptions caused by creatures or objects. This is a precise sense within the listed range. Intense fields, such as areas emitting radiation or auras of electricity, make creatures within them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to the diaspora worm.
items.description: 沙地蠕虫通过读取电磁场来感知周围环境，包括生物或物体造成的电磁扰动。在所列范围内，这是一种精确感官。强烈的电磁场（例如散发辐射的区域或带电灵光）会使身处其中的生物对沙地蠕虫@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

items.name: 舌抓
items.expectedDescription: A creature hit by the dust worm augur's tongue becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike against AC 42 that deals at least 38 slashing damage. This prevents the worm from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes 1 day.
items.description: 被蠕虫舌打击命中的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]。生物可尝试一次针对AC42的攻击，并且一次性至少造成38点挥砍伤害来切断其舌头。这会阻止蠕虫使用舌打击，直至其重新长出舌头（需1天）。

H53Dsx2DYmd9hBIn.name: 故障小魔怪
H53Dsx2DYmd9hBIn.publicNotes:
卑微的波特尼布，也被称作计算机故障小魔怪，与现代计算机设备及网络有着本能的羁绊。这些嬉戏的精类以制造混乱为使命，通过影响计算机系统在所到之处掀起骚动。他们天生具备与数字设备沟通的能力，常沉迷于这类系统，如同拼一副有趣的拼图般肆意破坏。

Gremlins have plagued the Universe with cruel tricks since long before the Gap, and they've fully adapted to a galaxy filled with technology. Whether meddling with a comm unit, a starship, or an entire space station, gremlins delight in ruination and chaos.

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 重填武器
items.expectedDescription:
You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its expend until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less.

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.
items.description:
你触碰一件没有剩余弹药的武器，用魔法能量为其充能。直到你的下一回合结束时，目标会获得与其“耗弹”相等的弹药或充能，并允许任何持有目标的人使用该武器进行一次打击。该法术只能为使用弹药且弹药价格不超过10个信用点的武器充能。

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.

items.name: 数字心灵感应
items.expectedDescription: A botnib can communicate telepathically with digital devices and with other creatures that can do so (such as other botnibs). This allows the botnib to attempt Computers checks to access any computer within the telepathy's range.
items.description: 故障小魔怪能够与数字设备和其他也能这样做的生物（例如其他故障小魔怪）进行心灵感应交流。这允许故障小魔怪尝试计算机检定来访问心灵感应范围内任意计算机。

items.name: 科技感知
items.expectedDescription: The botnib can sense items and creatures with the tech trait within 100 feet.
items.description: （侦测，原能） 故障小魔怪可以感知到100尺内具有科技特征的物品和生物。

HTupwGa1NQ6DeYlj.name: 漂流尸归返者
HTupwGa1NQ6DeYlj.publicNotes:
此类可悲灵魂中最卑微的便是归返者。他们的外观如同身前形态的扭曲版本，归返者用蠕动的爪状副肢拖着自己，亦或是用骇人的优雅姿态漂浮于太空中。归返者通常袭扰漂流信标、失事船只与真空岩石上。

Driftdead are created when a restless soul fuses with planar energies and reanimates its own corpse into a disturbing parody of life. Rarely, disturbed spirits snatched from elsewhere fuse together to inhabit a single dead body. Any death within the Drift might spawn a driftdead, but creatures that die in a frenzy of intense emotion are more likely to make the transition.

items.name: 黏丝
items.expectedDescription: A creature hit by the trawler's lasso filament becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the trawler. HWmGOBNNNvrzg5e1.name: 网暴魔（社交邪魔）
HWmGOBNNNvrzg5e1.publicNotes:
诞生于信息圈层与数字网络的网暴魔，是一种怀有恶意的力量，它们扭曲在线空间以折磨凡人。这些邪魔代表着社交媒体中压迫与仇恨所导致的死亡，它们隐匿于暗处，以极具破坏性的方式折磨敌人，甚至常常逼迫对方走上绝路。

Hailing from the plane of Abaddon, daemons are utterly devoted to the destruction of all life. Their existence is based around specific means of death, and they seek the death of all things in service to their lords: the Apocalypse Riders. Each daemon represents a different way to die, and they use their specific powers to further that means of death.

Advents in technology have only created new means of death and torment, so new types of daemons enter existence with regularity, each created once a sufficient mass of new deaths occurs to spawn them. These new advent daemons often prefer to spend their time in the galaxy rather than Abaddon, as they can better spread their torments to the mortals of creation.

items.name: 生命容器

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 跌绊术

items.name: 伪装身份
