items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 微灵盟友
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.
items.description:
你召唤一只小小的活跃微灵，能够分散意志最坚定的战斗人员的注意。微灵在你目标周围悬浮游弋。微灵没有占据空间，不会提供夹击，也没有其他生物会具有的属性。微灵能在10尺半径内产生明亮光照。当你施放该法术以及每次你维持该法术时，微灵试图分散目标的注意力。该目标必须通过意志豁免，否则在你下一回合开始前将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。豁免大成功的生物将对微灵盟友临时免疫1小时。

升阶（+1）你在施法时创造出额外一只微灵，这允许你选择一个额外目标。你创造的每个微灵都必须有不同的目标，并且当你维持该法术时，它们会同时分散各自目标的注意力。

items.name: 弧网
items.expectedDescription: The wyspiria can communicate through items and creatures with the tech trait, projecting sound from and speaking through the item or creature's voice, speakers, or other audio output. In addition, the excuba can use any item or creature with the tech trait within their digital telepathy aura as the point of origin for their spells and abilities when calculating range, distance, line of effect, and area of effect.
items.description: 光谱族可与具有科技特征的物品或生物沟通，通过它们的嗓音、扬声器或其他音频输出装置投射声音并说话。此外，在计算法术和能力的范围、距离、效果线、效果区域时，光谱族可将其数字心灵感应灵光内任何具有科技特性的物品或生物，作为其施放原点。

items.name: 滑移驱动
items.expectedDescription: An wyspiria has an internal biomechanical Drift engine, allowing them to function as a Drift engine for a starship or vehicle they pilot as a 1-minute activity. An excuba can enter or exit the Drift themself as a 1-minute activity. When an excuba gets a critical failure on a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot a Course through the Drift, they get a failure instead.
items.description: 光谱族内置生物机械漂流引擎，可作为自己所驾驶飞船或载具的漂流引擎——激活此功能需耗时1分钟。光谱族自行进入或离开漂流域时，也需耗时1分钟。当光谱族在通过漂流域导航或规划航线的驾驶检定中出现大失败时，结果将改为普通失败。

items.name: 科技感知
items.expectedDescription: The wyspiria senses creatures and objects with the tech trait as a precise sense within the listed range.
items.description: 在所列范围内，光谱族可将具有科技特性的生物和物体，以精确感知探测到。

SF6AsdUau2Y6OK52.name: 活化火器
SF6AsdUau2Y6OK52.publicNotes:
活化火器既是绝佳的训练辅助工具，亦可轻松用于防御物资免遭入侵者掠夺，或作为隐蔽哨兵发挥作用。

Objects can be animated in multiple ways for a variety of functions. Since ancient times, weapons and armor have been given life as guardians and sentries through magic or ritual.

items.name: 武器模式
items.expectedDescription: In the hands of its creator, an animated firearm is a commercial laser pistol. The creator can Interact to release the firearm into an adjacent space to act on its own, or to retrieve it from an adjacent space and use it as a weapon.
items.description: 在制造者手中，活化火器表现为商用型激光手枪。制造者可通过交互动作将其释放至相邻方格，使其自主行动；或从相邻方格回收该火器，重新作为武器使用。

SIYOmpdDILZlhcwA.name: 七芒星卫队雷霆战士
SIYOmpdDILZlhcwA.publicNotes: 七芒星卫队雷霆战士因其最常用的攻击形式之一而得名，他们为万古卫队及七芒星卫队的部队提供空中支援。他们以魔法与爆炸物轰击敌人，将目标逼出防御工事，使其进入小队其余成员的火力范围。此外，他们也常执行撤离任务，无论是护送重要资产至安全地带，还是抓俘虏进行审讯。

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一束熵射线，迅速且无差别地分解物质。进行远程法术攻击对抗目标的AC。如果命中，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；或者如果目标生物有科技特征，则会受到2d6持续性酸蚀伤害并陷入故障1。如果重击，伤害翻倍，并且如果目标生物有科技特征，则陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

升阶 （+1）增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 过热术
items.expectedDescription:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6. Increase the damage of touching affected objects by 3.
items.description:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。触碰受影响物体的伤害增加3

items.name: 回旋弹
items.expectedDescription:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一道由闪烁钢铁构成的旋转圆盘或光滑球体在目标之间弹射跃动。造成2d4钝击或挥砍伤害，需要进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 战术型破片手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d4[bleed]]

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 2d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击 @Damage[1d4[bleed]]

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 2d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.

items.name: 导航塑法
items.expectedDescription: The aeon guard Flies using their jetpack, tracing arcane sigils through the air with their motion to empower their spells. If the next action the aeon guard uses is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. In addition, if the spell requires an attack roll or a Reflex save, any targets of the spell that have lesser cover reduce the bonuses they gain from cover by 1 against the spell.
items.description: （专注，移动，塑法）万古卫队借助喷气背包飞行，其动作在空中划出奥术符文，以此强化法术。若万古卫队的下个动作是施放具备射程的法术，则该法术射程增加30尺。此外，若该法术需进行攻击掷骰或反射豁免，则法术的所有目标从次等掩蔽中获得的加值减少1点。

SQk1n2QaJWwBiSGW.name: 共情蜘蛛
SQk1n2QaJWwBiSGW.publicNotes:
共情蜘蛛对展现真诚共情的人怀有好感。虽然他们通常避免战斗，但若朋友受到威胁，共情蜘蛛会立即投入行动。

Empathnids have tremendous empathy for other creatures. The fact that the 8-inch spidery creatures come in a variety of colors and have a lifesaving venom likely explains why they're frequently used as companions or pets across the Pact Worlds.

items.name: 情绪感知
items.expectedDescription: This is a precise sense against creatures under an emotion effect or in the grips of overwhelming emotions (at the GM's discretion). Against other creatures, this is an imprecise sense. Creatures immune to emotion or mental effects or under the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} spell are undetectable by emotionsense.
items.description: 这是一种对处于情绪效果影响下或被强烈情绪支配（由GM判断）的生物的精确感官。对于其他生物，这事一种模糊感官。免疫情绪或心灵效果或处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq] 法术下过下的生物不能被情绪感知侦测到。

items.name: 精神支持
items.expectedDescription: Allies sharing the same space as the empathnid receive a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against emotion and mental effects.
items.description: （心灵） 与共情蜘蛛共享空间的盟友，在对抗情绪和心灵效果的豁免上获得+1环境加值。

SnEh8IjIko0y8USu.name: 实光魔蝠
SnEh8IjIko0y8USu.publicNotes:
这些生物通常酷似其诞生的广告或媒体载体，但它们也经常看上去像是蝙蝠模样的元素魔蝠，因而得名。

Unlike normal holograms, hardlight life-forms are tangible, living entities.

items.name: 回旋弹
items.expectedDescription:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一道由闪烁钢铁构成的旋转圆盘或光滑球体在目标之间弹射跃动。造成2d4钝击或挥砍伤害，需要进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 空中飘浮
items.expectedDescription: The atlapak can "swim" through the air in a thick atmosphere by inflating its lightweight body. Its fly Speed is reduced by half in a normal atmosphere, and it loses its fly Speed entirely while in an environment with a thin atmosphere or no atmosphere.
items.description: 音波虾可以通过膨胀其轻巧的身体在浓密大气中“游”过空气。在正常大气中，其飞行速度减半，而在稀薄大气或无大气环境中，它会完全失去飞行速度。

items.name: 稠密大气依赖
items.expectedDescription: An atlapak's sonic snap is most effective in thick atmosphere or underwater. In normal or thin atmosphere, the range increments of its Cavitation Blast and sonic snap Strike are reduced by half, its Cavitation Blast ignores only up to 5 Hardness, and the DC for its Cavitation Blast decreases by 2. An atlapak's sonic snap Strike can't function in environments with no atmosphere.
items.description: 音波虾的音波夹钳在浓密大气或水中最为有效。在正常或稀薄大气中，其气穴爆炸和音波夹钳打击的射程增量减半，其气穴爆炸只能忽略至多5点硬度，且气穴爆炸的DC减少2。音波虾的音波夹钳打击不能在无大气环境中起作用。

items.name: X光视域
items.expectedDescription: You empower yourself to see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white.
items.description: 你激活透视能力，可看穿60尺内大多数材质与墙体。你的视线会被2尺厚的木材或塑料，1尺厚的岩石，2寸厚的普通金属或者任意厚度的铅或星金阻隔，并且你的视野为黑白的。

items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 多肢灵巧
items.expectedDescription: A temporai can Switch Hands as a free action.
items.description: 时序护卫使可以使用一个自由动作换手

TIAKvaPlJiULdukC.name: 叠态幽骸
TIAKvaPlJiULdukC.publicNotes: 叠态幽骸是一种不死存在，它拥有两种交叠却并不协调的形态：一种是在无尽折磨中扭曲尖啸的灵魂，另一种则是满溢着宁静的漆黑骸骨。其中一种形态可能会看起显得更加真实，但在下一刻又变得截然相反。

items.name: 事件视界
items.expectedDescription: A vorthuul naturally draws in light. The DC of the flat check to target a vorthuul @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or hidden due to dim light or darkness is reduced by 2. A vorthuul takes a –2 circumstance penalty to AC and saving throws against light effects and to AC against attacks from weapons in the laser group.
items.description: 叠态幽骸会自然地吸引光线。当由于叠态幽骸昏暗光照或黑暗而获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]或藏匿时，你以它为目标作出的纯骰检定的DC会降低2点。叠态幽骸在对抗光亮效果时，AC和豁免会承受-2点环境减值，并且在对抗激光武器组的武器作出的攻击时，AC会承受-2点环境减值。

TvSLqbhQ9tZ3Ptp8.name: 废水灵
TvSLqbhQ9tZ3Ptp8.publicNotes:
工业废水若积存过久未处理，会在蒸发时从水元素位面吸引来废水灵。废水灵会污染其接触的一切，将坚实的土地与洁净的水源化为污泥。许多企业排污点和有毒物质泄漏处都会吸引或催生废水灵，而它们的存在又会进一步污染生态系统。

Elementals are energetic intrusions from the primal planes of existence. They take many forms, from mindless eddies in the wind or water to complex entities capable of wielding primal magic. The advent of space travel and the progress of technology have allowed even more living embodiments of the elements to manifest in the Universe.

Natural events like wildfires, solar storms, and floods can unleash hordes of unruly elementals on a planet or into a region of space. Sometimes, a gathering of powerful elementals causes a natural disaster on an epic scale, like an off-the-charts solar flare that fries a planet's power grid or a ceaseless storm swirling in a gas giant's atmosphere.

U5dR7Q1JtpyfMsIu.name: 机械化战术型战争机器
U5dR7Q1JtpyfMsIu.publicNotes:
多倍工业公司（Multifold Industries）与泽泽尔军械（Zeizerer Munitions）合作，研发了最早的远程操控战争机器之一。该机器代号“塔什塔里”，专为快速部署至战场而设计。它能远距离支援突击部队，同时干扰战场上的敌方通讯。

The incursion began with a series of probes detected by anacites on Aballon. Strange machines with blazing sensors and articulated tentacles appeared out of nowhere, ripping through infrastructure seemingly at random and collecting intelligence all around Pact Worlds space. Panic spread fast, but since the machines always vanished without a trace, or exploded when captured, the sightings couldn't be confirmed or identified. Rumors began to circulate that the machines were a form of biotech never encountered before. Soon the Stewards became formally involved, shuttering the incidents behind the adamantine partition of top security clearance.

In Sarenith of 325 ag, after dozens of military operations failed to engage the elusive probes, a wing of fighters dispatched from the Idari finally got lucky and disabled one of the machines before it could self-destruct. Coaxed into giving up some of its secrets by top Pact Worlds scientists, the biotech vessel became the prototype for the "home grown" remote war machines that are currently being tested for use in combat. The replicas aren't alive but are built using robotic construction templates since the core of the original biotech design has proven too complicated to reverse engineer with Pact technology.

Remote war machines are proxies that can be controlled from a great distance. The original biotech war machines connect to the pilot's mind through a psychic link or unknown radio frequency. Robotic remote war machines connect to a computer via data link, allowing the pilot to control their proxy using a keyboard, virtual reality rig, or even a vidgame controller.

items.name: 星际通讯
items.expectedDescription: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.
items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

UIkZXK6cDhbuoryC.name: 科扎德狼
UIkZXK6cDhbuoryC.publicNotes:
成群的狼形科扎代菌充当着科扎代真菌群落的眼睛和喉舌。

Corzadais spawned from the broken remains of Aucturn. Explosively launched into space, these fungal colonies are held together by mysterious forces. Their strange fruiting bodies have taken on numerous shapes, of which two have been more commonly seen in the Pact Worlds than others: corzads and corzadors.

items.name: 真菌共生
items.expectedDescription: A corzad's Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage to targets within 20 feet of at least two of the corzad's allies.
items.description: 当目标离至少两个科扎德狼的盟友的距离在20尺内时，科扎德狼的打击对目标造成额外1d4伤害。

UMBUxMCLszXV20mO.name: 石莲兽幼崽
UMBUxMCLszXV20mO.publicNotes:
石莲兽幼崽通过果实繁殖，在严酷的沙漠环境中这个过程可能持续数月。幼崽往往需要花费学习生存技能，才能准备好独立生活——或者被驱逐出去。

When rains grow sparse in this succulent's native habitat, it turns to another source for liquid: blood. The supenga has adapted to a world of scarcity and takes advantage of any chance to hunt using its sharp leaves and paralyzing toxin.

US4CO4Q85ZITI6W9.name: 星岩仙后
US4CO4Q85ZITI6W9.publicNotes:
一些直径达数英里的巨型小行星，是星岩仙后的栖息地。由于这些小行星更有可能拥有类似大气层的环境，星岩仙后习惯于与其他生物共享领地，并且只要它们自身及所处环境得到尊重，通常便不会介意（其他生物的存在）。

Nymphs are beautiful fey who appear as humanoids with elven features. They generally take female forms, but nymphs of all genders and presentations exist. While many nymphs live on planets and act as protectors of natural ponds, forests, caves, and cliffsides, other nymphs—often called space nymphs—are known for their association with celestial bodies. Like their planet-bound kin, space nymphs guard their bonded territories from exploitation or harm.

As admirers of the arts, nymphs are especially friendly toward creatives, and offering to depict a nymph in story, picture, or song is a sure way to win their favor—unless the nymph doesn't like the final result and lashes out at the artist for insulting them with a mediocre product. Vidcasting and livestreaming are popular pastimes among more sociable nymphs, whether to show off their remote environments or find audiences for performances. Some nymphs entice movie crews to film in their territories, with two provisos: first, that the production not damage the environment, and second, that the nymph receive a prominent role in the film.

Unless their territories are threatened, most space nymphs are friendly or indifferent to mortals, but they have long memories. Anyone visiting a space nymph's territory would be wise to research that nymph's grudges, past encounters with mortals, or any recent events in the area that might color the nymph's perspective of those traveling near their home.

A mortal who demonstrates the right attitude and abilities, such as by protecting a stellar body from destruction or creating an especially beautiful work of art, might draw a space nymph's attention. From time to time, space nymphs will offer their services as mentors to solarians or mystics, though they seldom seek pupils on their own. Space nymphs rarely enter into more than one such arrangement at a time and typically only make commitments that promise to last decades or centuries, so they're extremely selective in their choice of mentee.

items.name: 警示波动
items.expectedDescription:
You deter enemies with a wave of hostile intent. The target takes 7d8 nonlethal mental damage, and the target must attempt a Will save. The psychic energy then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the wave at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

Critical Success The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你通过心灵意志的波动遏制敌人。目标受到7d8非致命心灵伤害，目标需要尝试一次意志豁免。心灵能量随后会流向初始目标30尺内的另一个目标，再从那个目标跃向30尺内的另一个目标，以此类推。你可以在任何时候终止波动。你不能令同一生物多次成为目标，并且你必须对所有目标都具有效果线。你只投掷一次伤害并将它应用于每一个目标（根据豁免结果减半或加倍）。

大成功目标不受影响，波动在该目标处结束。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

大失败目标受到两倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加2d8。

items.name: 石塑形体
items.expectedDescription:
Your target's skin becomes a thick carapace of solid stone, granting resistance 5 to physical damage, except adamantine. The target gains a fist unarmed attack that deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The target uses their highest weapon or unarmed attack proficiency with these attacks, and if they have weapon specialization or greater weapon specialization, they add this damage as well. On a critical hit with one of these unarmed attacks, the creature struck must succeed at a Fortitude save against the target's class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.v724q5Xi7KPPnLQ3]

Heightened (6th) The resistance increases to 10, and the damage dealt by the attacks increases to 3d6.

Heightened (10th) The resistance increases to 20, and the damage dealt by the attacks increases to 4d6.
items.description:
你目标的肌肤化为坚固的石头甲壳，赋予对物理伤害的5点抗力，精金除外。目标获得拳头无武装攻击，造成2d6点钝击伤害。目标为此使用其最高的武器或无武装攻击熟练度，并且如果其具有武器专精或高等武器专精，其也可以应用此额外伤害。在使用此无武装攻击重击时，被重击生物必须成功通过一次强韧豁免，对抗目标的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}，持续1轮。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.v724q5Xi7KPPnLQ3]

升阶（6环）抗力提升至10，无武装攻击造成的伤害提升至3d6。

升阶（10环）抗力提升至20，无武装攻击造成的伤害提升至4d6。

items.name: 闪电枷锁
items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 生命容器
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

items.name: 腐蚀转化
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米粒子，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你会造成3d8酸蚀伤害加1d6持续酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 原子能爆破
items.expectedDescription:
You magically split an atom, creating an explosion with radioactive fallout. All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the @Check[fortitude]{Fortitude DC} for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the initial damage.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes double damage.
items.description:
You magically split an atom, creating an explosion with radioactive fallout. All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the @Check[fortitude]{Fortitude DC} for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

大成功目标不受初始伤害影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1分钟。

失败目标受到全额伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1分钟。

大失败同失败，目标受到双倍伤害。

items.name: 重力场
items.expectedDescription:
Bending the laws of the Universe to your will, you increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying and Climbing creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).
items.description:
你扭曲宇宙法则，增强一个区域内的重力。区域内所有飞行生物下降40尺。整个区域对飞行生物和攀爬生物来说是高等困难地形，对地面生物来说是困难地形。任何被重力场拉到地面上的生物都会受到钝击伤害，如同坠落一样。

该区域内的重力增加一级（例如，零重力变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，高重力变为极端重力）。

items.name: 钢墙术
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of solid steel. You create a 4-inch-thick wall of steel up to 120 feet long and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 18, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.
items.description:
你塑造一面固体钢墙。你创造一面4英尺厚，至多120尺长，20尺高的钢铁墙体。你可以塑造墙体的轨迹，将每一段5尺的墙放在方格的边界上。墙不需要垂直竖立，所以你可以用其来形成桥或者阶梯。你必须将墙召唤在连续的开放空间里，其边缘不能穿过任何生物或物体，否则法术便会失败。

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 18, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

升阶（+1）每段墙体的生命值增加15。

items.name: 火箭冲撞
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a rocket of flame from behind you and blast forward. You move in a straight line up to twice your Speed; you can move through spaces occupied by creatures, and the movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures in the area take 6d12 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 persistent fire damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. You reappear at the end of the line.

Heightened (+2) The fire damage increases by 2d12, and the persistent fire damage on a critical failure increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你向身后火箭喷射，极速向前冲刺。你直线移动两倍于你速度的距离，你可以穿过被生物占据的空间，并且这一移动不会触发反应。在区域内的生物受到6d12火焰伤害，这具有一次基础反射豁免。在大失败时，该生物还会额外受到2d6持续火焰伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1轮。你将重新出现在直线的终点。

升阶（+2）火焰伤害增加2d12，豁免大失败的持续火焰伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 切割现实
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. VmHWS0Jm6aBSEJIu.name: 机械化精英型战争机器
VmHWS0Jm6aBSEJIu.publicNotes:
代号为"奥罗瓦克"的战争机器（Aurovak）是当前协约世界机械化军事技术的巅峰之作，由一群精灵、弗米蚁族与拉申塔工程师在卡斯卓韦星的一项全新的联合计划下共同研发而成。

The incursion began with a series of probes detected by anacites on Aballon. Strange machines with blazing sensors and articulated tentacles appeared out of nowhere, ripping through infrastructure seemingly at random and collecting intelligence all around Pact Worlds space. Panic spread fast, but since the machines always vanished without a trace, or exploded when captured, the sightings couldn't be confirmed or identified. Rumors began to circulate that the machines were a form of biotech never encountered before. items.name: 持续脉冲雷达
items.expectedDescription: The war machine can detect all creatures and objects within 100 feet of itself, treating @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, and unobserved creatures as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
items.description: 该战争机器可探测自身周围100尺范围内的所有生物与物体，将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]及无踪状态的生物全部视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]状态。

items.name: 星际通讯
items.expectedDescription: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.
items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

items.name: 水下武装
items.expectedDescription: The superior war machine's ranged Strikes are launched with such high velocity that they can be used underwater without penalty.
items.description: 该战争机器的远程打击以极高速度发射，在水下使用时不会受到任何减值。

items.name: 臂炮
items.expectedDescription: A daipex's powerful arms can be fused into one or more cannons. These arm cannons also can't be Disarmed or Released. The daipex takes a –4 circumstance penalty to any action that requires fine motor control.
items.description: 暴射魔强健的手臂可以融合为一门或多门臂炮。这些臂炮同样无法被卸武或解除装置。此外，任何需要精细操作的动作，暴射魔都会受到 –4 环境减值。

items.name: 等离子墙
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of crackling plasma that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of plasma in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of plasma with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The persistent electricity damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你塑造一面由劈啪作响的等离子体形成的墙壁，其会燃烧通过的生物。你创造一条5尺厚，至多60尺长10尺高的直线墙体，或者5尺厚，10尺半径，相同高度的环形墙体。不论哪种形式，墙体都垂直竖立。如果你愿意，墙体可以更短或者更矮。墙体两侧的任何物体对彼此都是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]的。任何试图穿过墙体或者在墙体占据区域内开始回合的生物受到4d6火焰伤害和2d6持续电击伤害。

升阶（+1）持续电击伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 过热术
items.expectedDescription:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6. Increase the damage of touching affected objects by 3.
items.description:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。触碰受影响物体的伤害增加3

items.name: 感应应答
items.expectedDescription: While on their bonded celestial body, a nymph can sense approaching starships within a day's travel from the celestial body. This doesn't give them any information about the ship, its occupants, or its exact position. The nymph can send a message to the ship as if using a personal comm unit.
items.description: 当宁芙处于与其绑定的天体上时，她能感应到距离天体一天航程范围内的接近的星舰。这不会给她提供关于星舰、其乘员或其确切位置的任何信息。宁芙可以像使用个人通讯单元一样向星舰发送信息。

WgVbdad5NIqf86qc.name: 星岩角斗士
WgVbdad5NIqf86qc.publicNotes:
在宇宙的小行星带中，以及那些岩石天体的表面，栖息着这些热爱比拼的巨大元素生物——星岩角斗士。它们会在摔跤与跳跃时，用小行星碎片加固自己的身体。它们依赖小行星内部的养分茁壮成长，并会为保护家园免遭贪婪采矿企业的过度开采而战。

Elementals are energetic intrusions from the primal planes of existence. They take many forms, from mindless eddies in the wind or water to complex entities capable of wielding primal magic. The advent of space travel and the progress of technology have allowed even more living embodiments of the elements to manifest in the Universe.

Natural events like wildfires, solar storms, and floods can unleash hordes of unruly elementals on a planet or into a region of space. Sometimes, a gathering of powerful elementals causes a natural disaster on an epic scale, like an off-the-charts solar flare that fries a planet's power grid or a ceaseless storm swirling in a gas giant's atmosphere.

WmyIqf9u7s5KB86U.name: 奥罗科兰人
WmyIqf9u7s5KB86U.publicNotes:
大多数奥罗科兰人依附在散落于太空或极寒边域的奥克顿碎片上，尽可能吞噬新诞者子宫的碎片，并带着狂暴的食欲袭击任何靠近的生物。对于那些试图采集或搬运奥克腾岩的人，奥罗科兰人会展现出尤为激烈且毫不留情的暴力。

Native to the now-destroyed planet of Aucturn, orocorans are foul and desperate creatures, cast adrift in space as they yearn to consume once more the essence of the Newborn god or fragments of the womb it gestated within. They're irritable, violent, and utterly anguished.

While some orocorans have broken free of their addiction and regained their clarity of mind and sense of self, the orocorans presented here are those who still rely on Aucturn's eldritch fluids.

WsWO0Bq3ZPIXSbm7.name: 石莲兽泰坦
WsWO0Bq3ZPIXSbm7.publicNotes:
这些有毒的泰坦巨兽能瞬间吸干活物的血液。

When rains grow sparse in this succulent's native habitat, it turns to another source for liquid: blood. The supenga has adapted to a world of scarcity and takes advantage of any chance to hunt using its sharp leaves and paralyzing toxin.

XFkKAb7izGg4Gbbh.name: 接生圣者普雷苏莱
XFkKAb7izGg4Gbbh.publicNotes:
普雷苏莱的凡俗生命以自我牺牲以哺育新诞者告终。普雷苏莱被重塑为一团肆意生长的赘生物与跳动器官，生命能量在其间流转闪烁。

Thirteen mortal Midwives attended the Newborn's birth and were transformed into eldritch beings by the nascent outer god's awakening. A Midwife always regenerates an identical new form so long as even a single speck of aucturnite—the name for the frozen chunks of planetcenta that once surrounded the Newborn—exists on this plane.

There are 13 types of Midwives, but their true numbers are unknown. Whether their names come from the mortal servants whose souls were the kindling for the Midwives' creation or have some other significance to the Newborn, also remains a mystery.

Each Midwife identifies themself by how they cared for the Newborn: if they swaddled, fed, carried, held, watched, warded, blessed, or performed other acts of nurturing for the outer god. The Midwives are powerful beings capable of transdimensional travel. They might be encountered in liminal spaces, such as the Drift or the Ghost Levels of Absalom Station, or they might be found among the clouds of aucturnite debris in the Gelid Edge. Their incomprehensible actions always advance the Newborn's inscrutable agenda—or their own.

The most well-known encounter the Pact Worlds have had with the Midwives took place in the immediate aftermath of the Newborn's birth. Amnieka, who swaddled the Newborn and has a hood of writhing tentacles around their visage, attacked Absalom Station directly, causing a massive power surge that threatened the lives of everyone on board. Chaos ensued, but a group of adventurers—who happened to be in the right elevator at the right time—found themselves in the station's Ghost Levels, where they thwarted Amnieka and prevented the Midwife from draining the station's reactors. The Midwives haven't acted so directly since that incident, but many suspect it's only a matter of time, and no one knows just how powerful the others might be.

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力凝聚为一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值，或者如果你和一个至少有12点生命值的活力网络建立纽带，则可以从活力网络中扣除12点生命值。尝试一次远程法术攻击对抗目标AC。在命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。如果重击，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).

items.name: 刺激细胞
items.expectedDescription:
You vitalize and stimulate the target at a cellular level, giving it a temporary burst of energy that unfortunately takes an exhausting toll. The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action to Stride or Strike. After that round ends, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until it can rest for 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.
items.description:
你从细胞层面激发目标的活力，使其获得短暂的能量爆发，但不幸的是，这将使其精疲力竭。目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]状态，并可以使用额外的行动行走或打击。该轮结束后，目标会变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]，直到休息10分钟。

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 滋养灵光
items.expectedDescription: 100 feet. Presulea can sense the presence of any living creature inside their nourishing aura. This functions as an imprecise sense. Any spells with the healing or vitality trait are automatically heightened one rank (up to rank 4) if the caster is within the aura. Presulea treats a creature that casts such a spell as though they can always see it for 1 hour following the casting, ignoring the effects of any cover, concealment, invisibility, or similar effects.
items.description: （灵光，神术） 100尺。普雷苏莱能感知其滋养灵光内任何生物的存在。这视作一种模糊感官。如果施法者身处灵光内，任何具有治疗特征或命能特征的法术被自动升阶一环（至多到4环）。普雷苏莱将施放了此类法术的生物视为始终能被其看见，持续到施法1小时后，忽视任何掩蔽，隐蔽，隐形，或类似效果的效果。

items.name: 返回奥克腾
items.expectedDescription: Presulea teleports to the location of any aucturnite fragment within a planetary range. Presulea automatically uses this ability as a free action when reduced to 0 Hit Points as long as a piece of aucturnite is within range, reforming their body and recovering completely over the next 24 hours.
items.description: （传送） 普雷苏莱传送至行星距离内任意有奥克腾岩的位置。如果普雷苏莱降至0生命值，它以自由动作自动使用此能力，并且只要奥克腾岩处于范围内，它就能在24小时候重构其身体并完全恢复。

XPnaCwBoyc5nNE20.name: 克鲁维兽终灵
XPnaCwBoyc5nNE20.publicNotes:
克鲁维兽是是栖息于卡冷五号（Calen-5）的微型有蹄类生物，该星球为湿润的树木世界。当维斯卡里姆的采矿公司在卡冷五号发现稀有星金后，采矿热潮摧毁了该行星的赤道雨林，导致克鲁维兽灭绝。多年后，定居者报告遭遇神秘的财产损毁事件，并目睹幽灵般的野兽疯狂拆解遇到的任何科技设备。

Every species follows a natural arc as it emerges and evolves: rising, thriving, declining, and falling into extinction. When extremely unnatural ends to these paths occur—when unexpected predation, industrialization, or alien pathogens wipe out a population—endlings are born. These spectral members of extinct species typically develop as "answers" to their eradication. Xenobiologists differ on what creates endlings, unable to confirm whether the creatures are a species' last collective sorrow made manifest or just vengeful individual spirits—the last lights to go out.

items.name: 科技感知
items.expectedDescription: A koruvi endling can sense the presence of creatures and objects with the tech trait as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 克鲁维兽终灵能在所列范围能以精确感官感知到具有科技特征的生物和物体的存在。

XUXGvfT1PAvueWTF.name: 炽光仙后
XUXGvfT1PAvueWTF.publicNotes:
炽光仙后栖居于最大的矮星、成熟恒星以及超巨星之上。她们以自身恒星的耀眼光芒为傲，常常身着特制衣物，这些衣物能折射光线，以彰显其家园的璀璨光芒。

Nymphs are beautiful fey who appear as humanoids with elven features. They generally take female forms, but nymphs of all genders and presentations exist. While many nymphs live on planets and act as protectors of natural ponds, forests, caves, and cliffsides, other nymphs—often called space nymphs—are known for their association with celestial bodies. Like their planet-bound kin, space nymphs guard their bonded territories from exploitation or harm.

As admirers of the arts, nymphs are especially friendly toward creatives, and offering to depict a nymph in story, picture, or song is a sure way to win their favor—unless the nymph doesn't like the final result and lashes out at the artist for insulting them with a mediocre product. Vidcasting and livestreaming are popular pastimes among more sociable nymphs, whether to show off their remote environments or find audiences for performances. Some nymphs entice movie crews to film in their territories, with two provisos: first, that the production not damage the environment, and second, that the nymph receive a prominent role in the film.

Unless their territories are threatened, most space nymphs are friendly or indifferent to mortals, but they have long memories. Anyone visiting a space nymph's territory would be wise to research that nymph's grudges, past encounters with mortals, or any recent events in the area that might color the nymph's perspective of those traveling near their home.

A mortal who demonstrates the right attitude and abilities, such as by protecting a stellar body from destruction or creating an especially beautiful work of art, might draw a space nymph's attention. From time to time, space nymphs will offer their services as mentors to solarians or mystics, though they seldom seek pupils on their own. Space nymphs rarely enter into more than one such arrangement at a time and typically only make commitments that promise to last decades or centuries, so they're extremely selective in their choice of mentee.
