Heightened (+1) The persistent electricity damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你塑造一面由劈啪作响的等离子体形成的墙壁，其会燃烧通过的生物。你创造一条5尺厚，至多60尺长10尺高的直线墙体，或者5尺厚，10尺半径，相同高度的环形墙体。不论哪种形式，墙体都垂直竖立。如果你愿意，墙体可以更短或者更矮。墙体两侧的任何物体对彼此都是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]的。任何试图穿过墙体或者在墙体占据区域内开始回合的生物受到4d6火焰伤害和2d6持续电击伤害。

升阶（+1）持续电击伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 闪电枷锁
items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 辐射术
items.expectedDescription:
You rapidly destabilize and decay the atoms around you to create a burst of magically enhanced mild radiation. Creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against mild radiation sickness. This magical radiation uses your spell DC in place of the radiation's normal Fortitude DC, has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round. Technology doesn't gain the glitching condition from the radiation created by this spell.

Heightened (5th) The radiation increases to severe.

Heightened (7th) The radiation increases to extreme.

Heightened (9th) The radiation increases to incredible.
items.description:
You rapidly destabilize and decay the atoms around you to create a burst of magically enhanced mild radiation. Creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against mild radiation sickness. This magical radiation uses your spell DC in place of the radiation's normal Fortitude DC, has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round. Technology doesn't gain the glitching condition from the radiation created by this spell.

升阶（5 环）辐射增至严重。

升阶（7 环）辐射增至极度。

升阶（9 环）辐射增至严酷。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力凝聚为一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值，或者如果你和一个至少有12点生命值的活力网络建立纽带，则可以从活力网络中扣除12点生命值。尝试一次远程法术攻击对抗目标AC。在命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。如果重击，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 过热术
items.expectedDescription:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6. Increase the damage of touching affected objects by 3.
items.description:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。触碰受影响物体的伤害增加3

items.name: 感应应答
items.expectedDescription: While on their bonded celestial body, a nymph can sense approaching starships within a day's travel from the celestial body. This doesn't give them any information about the ship, its occupants, or its exact position. The nymph can send a message to the ship as if using a personal comm unit.
items.description: 当宁芙处于与其绑定的天体上时，她能感应到距离天体一天航程范围内的接近的星舰。这不会给她提供关于星舰、其乘员或其确切位置的任何信息。宁芙可以像使用个人通讯单元一样向星舰发送信息。

items.name: 红外视觉
items.expectedDescription: A draiclipsed can detect infrared radiation (such as that given off by warm-blooded creatures) as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 蚀光影骸能够在所列范围内以模糊感官侦测到红外辐射（例如由温血生物散发）。

items.name: 日蚀寿衣
items.expectedDescription: 15 feet. A draiclipsed absorbs light and is perpetually surrounded by shifting shadows and lengthening darkness. Light in the area decreases by one step (for example, bright light becomes dim light).
items.description: （灵光，黑暗）15尺。蚀光影骸吸收光照，周围永久被变幻阴影和不断加深的黑暗笼罩。区域内的光照下降一级（例如，明亮光照变为昏暗光照）。

items.name: 剿灭叛徒
items.expectedDescription: Whenever a draiclipsed would deal void damage to an undead or other creature with void healing, that void damage becomes cold damage instead.
items.description: 当蚀光影骸对不死生物或其他具有虚能治疗的生物造成虚能伤害时，该虚能伤害改为寒冷伤害。

items.name: 聚集黑暗
items.expectedDescription: If at least one other draiclipsed is within the draiclipsed's eclipse shroud, the draiclipsed's Strikes deal an additional 1d8 void damage.
items.description: 如果至少一个其他蚀光影骸处于蚀光影骸的日蚀寿衣内，蚀光影骸的打击造成额外1d8虚能伤害。

Xt6ybUlOJ91cVeaJ.name: 科扎多尔人
Xt6ybUlOJ91cVeaJ.publicNotes:
这些外形大致上类似人类的科扎多尔人驱使着科扎德狼群，执行着他们那残酷的任务。

Corzadais spawned from the broken remains of Aucturn. Explosively launched into space, these fungal colonies are held together by mysterious forces. Their strange fruiting bodies have taken on numerous shapes, of which two have been more commonly seen in the Pact Worlds than others: corzads and corzadors.

XzzHer0NpA4zPhRg.name: 乌尔加扎级相位兽
XzzHer0NpA4zPhRg.publicNotes:
曾被记录过的最大的相位兽是“不老的”乌尔加扎（Ulgaaza the Ageless），这只神话生物如此古老，如此巨大，足以令群山相形见绌。如今，任何达到史诗级体型的相位兽都被称作“乌尔加扎级”，尽管这些巨兽与它们的命名者相比仍不值一提。

Incredibly ferocious, nyssholoras are dinosaur-like creatures that number among the most dangerous and feared apex predators on the planet of Castrovel. These walking weapons brandish lethal biology: a massive maw lined with twin rows of razor-sharp teeth, scythe-shaped phasic blade forearms that vibrate at ultrasonic speeds, and a scourge-like tail capable of absorbing electricity from the surrounding atmosphere. Yet, nyssholoras are also cunning and perceptive—a frill of tentacles that crowns their head detect telepathic signals, making it impossible for the local formians and lashuntas to escape their notice. Their phasic blades can cut through walls and vehicles as easily as underbrush, ensuring prey have nowhere safe to hide.

items.name: 心灵感应感知
items.expectedDescription: A nyssholora senses all creatures that have telepathy, limited telepathy, or a similar ability, such as a mystic's bond, as an imprecise sense at the listed range. This sense works through walls and other obstacles.
items.description: （原能） 相位兽能感知拥有心灵感应，有限心灵感应或类似能力的所有生物，例如秘术师的纽带，作为一种具有所列范围的模糊感官。此感官能够穿透墙壁和其他障碍物。

items.name: 相位打击
items.expectedDescription: A nyssholora's phasic blade Strike treats any object or construct it hits as if the target had half as much Hardness as usual.
items.description: 相位兽的相位刃打击将被其命中的任何物体或构装体视作硬度比通常情况减半。

Y8okEtUTLY4ZG1ki.name: 棘刺掠吼龙
Y8okEtUTLY4ZG1ki.publicNotes:
体型粗壮、肌肉发达的棘刺掠吼龙生活在开阔的平原、台地和高原上。与大多数掠吼龙不同，它们的褶边是一种致命的武器，上面排列着数百根长达一尺的尖刺，既是出色的防御手段，也是致命的武器。

Renkrodas are a family of large dinosaur-like predators native to the planet Castrovel. They've spread beyond the jungle planet's boundaries thanks to smugglers, poachers, and ultra-wealthy big-game hunters. Bipedal and strong with long necks and decorative spines, renkrodas are best known for their terrifying roars, which they bellow frequently as a form of long-range communication and to scare away other predators and scavengers. Over a dozen species of renkrodas exist, each specially adapted to their environment or ecological niche.

YH16QzUQB3LPZ36R.name: 恐惧共情蜘蛛
YH16QzUQB3LPZ36R.publicNotes:
恐惧共情蜘蛛是原生在丛林行星的致命猎手。它们在人口稠密的世界中繁衍兴盛，偏好捕食智慧类人生物。这些生物被负面情绪吸引，在猎物垂死之际吸收其恐惧，并将这些恐怖体验注入自身蛛网之中。

Empathnids have tremendous empathy for other creatures. The fact that the 8-inch spidery creatures come in a variety of colors and have a lifesaving venom likely explains why they're frequently used as companions or pets across the Pact Worlds.

items.name: 情绪感知
items.expectedDescription: This is a precise sense against creatures under an emotion effect or in the grips of overwhelming emotions (at the GM's discretion). Against other creatures, this is an imprecise sense. Creatures immune to emotion or mental effects or under the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} spell are undetectable by emotionsense.
items.description: 这是一种对处于情绪效果影响下或被强烈情绪支配（由GM判断）的生物的精确感官。对于其他生物，这事一种模糊感官。免疫情绪或心灵效果或处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq] 法术下过下的生物不能被情绪感知侦测到。

items.name: 菌丝网络
items.expectedDescription: Psychic fungi are connected to a network of psychic filaments bonding all psychic fungi from the same colony. This network grants the elder the ability to detect creatures capable of thought within 30 feet of a bonded psychic fungus up to 1,000 feet away as an imprecise sense.
items.description: 心能真菌与来自同一菌落的所有心能真菌之间，通过一个由心灵菌丝构成的网络相互连接。这一网络赋予采集者一种模糊感官，使其能够探测到距离相互联结的心能真菌30尺以内、且距离自身最远可达1000尺的具有思维能力的生物。

items.name: 汲取脑髓
items.expectedDescription: The elder psychic fungus consumes the fluids and psychic essences from the brain of a creature within 10 feet that has been dead for no more than 1 minute. The elder psychic fungus regains the use of their highest-ranked spent innate spell. The creature is considered to have died due to a death effect.
items.description: （操作）心能真菌长老从 10 尺内一只死亡不超过 1 分钟的生物的大脑中汲取液体和心能精华。心能真菌长老恢复其最高环级已消耗的内在法术。该生物被视为因一个死亡效果而死亡。

YiT1jMt24I8pdX6x.name: 艾琳卓祭司
YiT1jMt24I8pdX6x.publicNotes:
这些艾琳卓战士沉溺于暴力。他们唯一的动机似乎是传播痛苦，而他们自身却不知痛苦；其神经末梢的特殊构造使他们完全感受不到疼痛，即便经历痛苦也几乎不会遭受折磨。只要附近有艾琳卓女王能复活他们，这些祭司便终日相互厮杀，磨砺施暴能力，直至更优质的猎物出现。

The people known as elindrians vanished eons ago into desolate husk-hives beneath the surface of the planet Castrovel. Until recently, they were creatures of legend, existing only in the most obscure formian histories. Now, scholars on Castrovel desperately search for additional records about elindrians, their origins, and—most importantly—the truth about their connection to the terrifying ooze-like creature that recently descended from their moon, Elindrae. One theory is that elindrians share some primal bond with the ooze-thing called the Terror of Ukulam, and perhaps both originate from Elindrae—other theories claim that elindrians created the ooze in the first place or that they're distant cousins to formians, corrupted by the Terror long ago.

items.name: 痛苦羁绊
items.expectedDescription: A celebrant's painsaw is powered by the heart of another celebrant. If a celebrant is within 30 feet of a painsaw that contains their heart when the painsaw Strikes a creature, the celebrant regains a number of Hit Points equal to their level (typically 4). It's taboo for a celebrant to wield a painsaw made from their own heart or a heart from any celebrant whose death they didn't witness (or cause) themself. A painsaw otherwise functions in all ways like a painglaive but doesn't function with normal batteries. A single celebrant heart functions as a tactical battery when used with a painsaw; it recharges if the celebrant spends 10 minutes in the presence of an elindrian queen.
items.description: 祭司的苦痛之锯由另一名祭司的心脏驱动。当一名祭司位于一件装有其心脏的苦痛之锯30尺内，当该苦痛之锯打击一个生物时，此祭司恢复等同于其等级（通常为4）的生命值。祭司持用由自身心脏制成的苦痛之锯，或使用未亲眼见证（或亲手造成）其死亡的祭司心脏制成的苦痛之锯，皆属禁忌。除了不能使用正常电池外，其余所有功能苦痛之锯与苦痛大砍刀类似。在使用苦痛之锯时，一颗祭司的心脏视作一块战术型电池；当祭司在艾琳卓女王面前待上十分钟时，该心脏即可再充能。

ZDNakdcXH86fTWbA.name: 扬尘兽
ZDNakdcXH86fTWbA.publicNotes:
单只扬尘兽并不构成太大威胁，但对于依赖科技的人而言却可能带来麻烦。一些扬尘兽饲养者会在宠物完成每日的尘浴（dust baths）后，额外花时间陪它们玩耍——尤其是在进入星舰或其他设施前，因为在这些地方，突如其来的尘雾可能会引发灾难性后果。

These dusty, long-eared fluffy burrowing rodents are native to Daimalko and emerged alongside the colossi during the Awakening 200 years ago. They were initially heralded as potential pets and affectionately referred to as "dust bunnies," but the survivors of the Awakening soon found the species were as dangerous as the colossi rampaging across the planet.

While one or two pachinyams behave as calm herbivores, they reproduce rapidly. When the pachinyam population reaches a tipping point, they become vicious predators. Their dust's ability to disrupt both visual and telecommunications makes it challenging for settlements to warn or organize against them. Outside civilization, the pachinyam population is kept in check by their swarms' instinctually drive to be near colossi despite the obvious danger. Some also hypothesize that the scent of a pachinyam swarm's dust cloud attracts hungry colossi.

a7AYHtCQvlg6pFdu.name: 金乔锐蜥终灵
a7AYHtCQvlg6pFdu.publicNotes:
金乔锐蜥是长条形的四足爬行动物，它们在普里奥里八号（Priori-8）沙漠世界上挖掘出纵横交错的隧道系统。它们的虹彩鳞片会生长成密集的装甲板，抵御那些觊觎其华丽颈饰作为时尚配饰的猎人。偷猎者开始向金乔锐蜥的隧道里灌注毒气，这种手段效果惊人，最终导致该物种灭绝。多年后，造访普里奥里八号的访客仍会瞥见发着微光的妖蜥在洞穴隧道中悄然尾随，而偷猎者则会窒息于幽魂毒素之中。

Every species follows a natural arc as it emerges and evolves: rising, thriving, declining, and falling into extinction. When extremely unnatural ends to these paths occur—when unexpected predation, industrialization, or alien pathogens wipe out a population—endlings are born. These spectral members of extinct species typically develop as "answers" to their eradication. Xenobiologists differ on what creates endlings, unable to confirm whether the creatures are a species' last collective sorrow made manifest or just vengeful individual spirits—the last lights to go out.

items.name: 猎手视觉
items.expectedDescription: A jinchori can sense the presence of any creature wielding weapons as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 金乔锐蜥能在所列范围内以精确感官感知到任何持用武器的生物。

aAWtjfkVMft4iChR.name: 扬尘兽集群
aAWtjfkVMft4iChR.publicNotes:
扬尘兽集群能够扬起滚滚尘雾，因为每只扬尘兽不断将尘土重新蹭到同伴身上。

These dusty, long-eared fluffy burrowing rodents are native to Daimalko and emerged alongside the colossi during the Awakening 200 years ago. They were initially heralded as potential pets and affectionately referred to as "dust bunnies," but the survivors of the Awakening soon found the species were as dangerous as the colossi rampaging across the planet.

While one or two pachinyams behave as calm herbivores, they reproduce rapidly. When the pachinyam population reaches a tipping point, they become vicious predators. Their dust's ability to disrupt both visual and telecommunications makes it challenging for settlements to warn or organize against them. Outside civilization, the pachinyam population is kept in check by their swarms' instinctually drive to be near colossi despite the obvious danger. Some also hypothesize that the scent of a pachinyam swarm's dust cloud attracts hungry colossi.

items.name: 尘雾
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. The pachinyam swarm shakes it thick fur and releases a cloud of dust and dander in a 30-foot radius burst centered on a corner of one of its squares that functions as a mist spell. This dust cloud blocks electronic communication to and from anyone inside the cloud. Any item with the tech trait becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} if it's inside the dust cloud.
items.description: （灵光） 30尺范围。该效果视同迷雾术。这团尘雾会阻断区域内所有生物传出与收到的电子通讯。任何具有科技特征的物品若处于尘雾中，将陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 Glitching 1}1。

aJcV6CI77HVthUe4.name: 烬蛛族士兵
aJcV6CI77HVthUe4.publicNotes:
在烬蛛族战帮中，地位最低的是下级士兵。这些烬蛛族会通过如下方式证明自身实力：他们冲向敌人，使用武器开火射击，并挥动锋利的腿刃近身搏杀。那些存活足够长时间的士兵会得到认可，并在艰苦的烬蛛族军旅生活中获得晋升。

Jinsuls are a warlike species scattered across the Vast. Six-legged creatures with a bulbous body covered in eyes, jinsuls have notable segments of chitin along with a set of upper forelimbs for using equipment. They long ago lived in the region of space known as the Scoured Stars but eventually departed and settled on the harsh world of Rax. In recent years, the divine herald Dhurus unified the jinsuls into a cohesive force known as the Jinsul Hierocracy, which briefly retook the Scoured Stars. A joint alliance between several species and members of the Starfinder Society defeated Dhurus and scattered the jinsuls back into the Vast.

With countless bases and fleets operating in deep space, jinsuls mostly act as raiders, scavenging for equipment and testing their mettle against other species. Indoctrinated to view themselves as a superior species, with only other inhabitants of the Scoured Stars having any value, jinsuls prefer to engage in short-ranged combat with their foes.

Jinsuls aren't numerous enough to fill every need on the many ships and starbases they control across the galaxy. Instead, they rely on robots and automated computer systems (always commanded by at least one jinsul officer) to keep their space stations running efficiently. These systems are programmed to be just as deadly and ruthless as jinsuls themselves; even the most innocuous automated system or robot, like a garbage collector, might wield deadly weapons or contain vicious technomagical countermeasures.

items.name: 尾击
items.expectedDescription: The surnoch's tail smash has a burst centered on a corner of its space. It's excluded from the burst.
items.description: 噬矿蠕虫尾击的爆发范围以自身空间的一角为中心，他所的空间本身不纳入爆发范围。

items.name: 掘洞专家
items.expectedDescription: Surnochs have adapted to move swiftly underground. When burrowing, a surnoch worm leaves a tunnel behind itself. When moving through a previously created surnoch tunnel, it gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed.
items.description: 噬矿蠕虫已适应快速地下移动。掘地时，噬矿蠕虫会在身后留下一条隧道；当通过先前自己挖掘的隧道移动时，其速度获得+10尺状态加值。

aj2YwRIfeI1Ol2U2.name: 虚空泥怪
aj2YwRIfeI1Ol2U2.publicNotes:
虚空泥怪是星系乃至更远的星际航行者的祸患，它们从影界渗入物质宇宙。这些生物在永恒休眠中漂浮于太空，直至降落于行星或星舰，被微弱的生命迹象唤醒。如果某只泥怪有幸觅得战场，一夜之间便能形成庞大的殖民群落，先在无人区吞噬亡者与伤者，继而蔓延至战疲士兵的营地.

Oozes of many types lurk in dark and abandoned places across the galaxy, emerging only to satiate their appetites and threaten adventurers, explorers, and hapless workers alike.

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙之外，不可名状的力量，对区域内所有生物造成3d12心灵伤害，如同幻影尖爪、啃咬或是触须击中每个目标。区域中的每个生物都需要尝试一次意志豁免。区域对每个因该法术效果陷入恶心的生物都视为困难地形。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

大失败该生物受到两倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 岁月重担
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检查时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 毒素感知
items.expectedDescription: A zitteroc can detect poison as an imprecise sense at the listed range, including poisonous substances, poisoned creatures, and creatures with attacks that inflict poison.
items.description: 嗜毒蜥能以模糊感官在指定范围内探测毒素，包括有毒物质、中毒生物以及攻击时能造成毒素伤害的生物。

items.name: 强化武器
items.expectedDescription:
You infuse the weapon with magic allowing it to safely operate beyond its normal parameters. If the target is a commercial or tactical weapon, it becomes an advanced weapon, gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice to two.

Heightened (6th) If the target is a commercial, tactical, advanced, or superior weapon, it becomes an elite weapon, gaining a +2 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice to three.

Heightened (9th) The target becomes a paragon weapon, gaining a +3 to item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice to four.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.yopd0S7smKU5eB07]
items.description:
你将魔力灌注至武器中，使其能安全突破常规运作极限。如果目标是商用型或战术型武器，它变为先进型武器，在攻击骰上获得+1物品价值，并且伤害骰增加到2个。

Heightened (6th) If the target is a commercial, tactical, advanced, or superior weapon, it becomes an elite weapon, gaining a +2 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice to three.

Heightened (9th) The target becomes a paragon weapon, gaining a +3 to item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice to four.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.yopd0S7smKU5eB07]

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 微灵盟友
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.
items.description:
你召唤一只小小的活跃微灵，能够分散意志最坚定的战斗人员的注意。微灵在你目标周围悬浮游弋。微灵没有占据空间，不会提供夹击，也没有其他生物会具有的属性。微灵能在10尺半径内产生明亮光照。当你施放该法术以及每次你维持该法术时，微灵试图分散目标的注意力。该目标必须通过意志豁免，否则在你下一回合开始前将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。豁免大成功的生物将对微灵盟友临时免疫1小时。

升阶（+1）你在施法时创造出额外一只微灵，这允许你选择一个额外目标。你创造的每个微灵都必须有不同的目标，并且当你维持该法术时，它们会同时分散各自目标的注意力。

items.name: 妖精锤子
items.expectedDescription: In the hands of an obrhinnshee, all hammers gain a reach of 10 feet and are treated as magical weapons.
items.description: 在引魂精手中时，所有锤子触及范围扩展至10尺，并视为魔法武器

bgiNmocKmS5xdELg.name: 尸花兽
bgiNmocKmS5xdELg.publicNotes:
尸花兽起源于卡斯卓韦的无心智植物，在暴露于弗米蚁族与拉申塔人冲突中所释放的心能数千年后，它们演化出了初步的智力与惊人的适应能力。这些身长12尺的四足生物拥有多达十几条的面部触须，并通过从触须团两侧伸出的两根眼柄来观察世界。尸花兽在从猎物体内汲取遗传密码后，其可变的形体可能会暂时长出蹼、翅膀或其他适应性结构。尸花兽最初是食腐动物，但如今已演化为致命猎手，能够将其消化系统与生殖系统转化为武器。它们体内用于消化猎物的强酸可以以致命的唾液的形式喷射出去，而其身体两侧的数十根尖刺则携带其遗传密码，可如投射物般发射出去，使幼年尸花兽在成长过程中能够以受害者为食。幼体的易于传播以及其环境适应能力，使得尸花兽的分布已远远超出了卡斯卓韦。

Originally scavengers, ksariks have evolved into deadly hunters capable of weaponizing their digestive and reproductive systems. The internal acid ksariks use to digest prey can be projected as lethal spittle. The dozens of thorns along their sides carry their genetic code and can be launched as projectiles, allowing ksarik saplings to feed off a victim as they grow. This easy transmittal of their young and their environmental adaptability have allowed ksariks to spread far beyond Castrovel.

items.name: 适应性语言
items.expectedDescription: A ksarik understands up to 3 languages from among the prevalent languages spoken by those it has most recently attacked.
items.description: 尸花兽能理解其最近攻击过的生物所使用的主流语言（prevalent languages）中的至多三种。

bp4ChaSm9436oH68.name: 尸骸舰队步兵
bp4ChaSm9436oH68.publicNotes:
尸骸舰队的普通步兵都经过协同作战的训练。

The Corpse Fleet is an army made up of undead supremacists who refuse to bow to the will of the living. Founded by defectors from the Eoxian navy, the Corpse Fleet aims to shatter Pact Worlds unity and liberate Eox from the influence of the living and those bone sages who sided with them. Unyielding and utterly ruthless, the Corpse Fleet deals in death and destruction, feeding on the living and exploiting the dead.

items.name: 齐射
items.expectedDescription: The Corpse Fleet infantry's ranged Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage when the Corpse Fleet infantry is within the first range increment of at least one other member of the Corpse Fleet wielding a ranged weapon.
items.description: 当尸骸舰队步兵处于至少一名持用有远程武器的其他尸骸舰队成员的第一个射程增量内时，其远程打击造成额外1d4精准伤害。

bqqVBryPyM6Ho8BN.name: 数字幽灵电子游戏玩家
bqqVBryPyM6Ho8BN.publicNotes:
一些电子游戏玩家如此沉迷上网，以至于他们能显化出数字幽灵。

Digital ghosts are data constructs crafted from forgotten user accounts and metadata that are gathered and formatted into a simulacrum of the source user.

cZq0Rm1CoW7MPeuI.name: 悖论17
cZq0Rm1CoW7MPeuI.publicNotes:
由于悖论17通常不可见，大多数记录的观测都始于听到一声轰鸣，“如同失效信号的杂音”。所有报告都提到一种深刻却难以定位的意义感。一位幸存者目睹它被一道光芒照亮，她形容那光芒“如同由闪亮的眼睛和玻璃羽毛构成的螺旋星系”。另一人则描述它为——“数十对交错的翅膀，其间散落着余烬”。然而关于悖论17唯一可确定的，是若正面遭遇它将无比致命。

Can you ever really know that the Universe you perceive exists? That you'll never awaken one day to find it was all a dream? A planet full of philosophers sought the answers to these questions once upon a time… shortly before they all vanished en masse. They left behind confusing records stating that the light of a "whirling star" revealed that physical matter had no substance and the Universe was secretly a mental prison. These records are all that remain from the first known encounter with the being known as Paradox 17.

items.name: 事件视界
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash the power of a supermassive black hole. All creatures in the area take 6d10 bludgeoning and 6d10 void damage. Event horizon ignores up to 10 resistance creatures in the area have to bludgeoning, and up to 10 resistance they have to void. Each creature attempts a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3} until the end of its next turn, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你释放出超大黑洞的力量。区域内的所有生物都会受到6d10钝击伤害和6d10虚能伤害。事件视界可无视区域内生物最多10点钝击抗力与最多10点虚能抗力。每个生物都尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}直到他的下个回合结束。

失败该生物受到全额伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 3}直到他的下个回合结束，在接下来陷入持续1分钟的缓慢1。

items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

items.description:

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

dfQw3yXo0X1O5sMf.name: 辐照不死飞行者
dfQw3yXo0X1O5sMf.publicNotes:
飞行者是对有翼生物的统称，例如龙兽，巨蜻蜓，猛禽和其他被重度辐射复生的飞行野兽。

To survive in the unforgiving expanse of space, creatures must be naturally adapted or take protective measures. While the dead rarely need such precautions against these threats, sometimes radiation can animate a corpse (or several) to a state of undeath!

Scientists and religious scholars alike debate whether a specific type of radiation is to blame for this phenomenon that spontaneously triggers unlife, but all agree on the dangers such irradiated creatures pose. Many types of radiation could be the cause: intense bursts of cosmic radiation emitted by the stars, magically enhanced radioactive isotopes found in a planet's or moon's crust, or even the advent of new energy sources in a society (or its radioactive waste) contaminating the land. Regardless of their specific origin, irradiated undead all pose the same threat—they emit ionizing radiation that ravages everything around them.

items.expectedDescription: 20 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn inside the aura is exposed to severe radiation.
items.description: （灵光，辐射） 20尺。进入灵光或在其中开始回合的生物遭受重度辐射（《主持人核心》91页）。

dxbr3LNg0R66Aj1n.name: 电控丧尸
dxbr3LNg0R66Aj1n.publicNotes:
最常见的科技丧尸就是电控丧尸，但科技丧尸也可能通过其他技术方式唤起，包括纳米体。

Technological zombies are created when a dead creature is reanimated (or otherwise kept moving) by an internal or integrated technological item—usually an augmentation. Despite the vast differences in form and hardware between different tech zombies, they do have similarities—they're mindless undead driven to harm the living, with technological components and weaknesses that can be leveraged.

f4QeUAZrfeIFZRHD.name: 烬蛛族祭司
f4QeUAZrfeIFZRHD.publicNotes:
祭司能在战事陷入困境时激发烬蛛族近乎自杀般的狂热。他们兼具施法者与演说家的特质，是鼓舞士气的战场领袖。每位祭司都效忠于一位烬蛛族大祭司（major jinsul hierarchs），而这些大祭司则轮流担任整个烬蛛族神权国的领袖。

Jinsuls are a warlike species scattered across the Vast. Six-legged creatures with a bulbous body covered in eyes, jinsuls have notable segments of chitin along with a set of upper forelimbs for using equipment. They long ago lived in the region of space known as the Scoured Stars but eventually departed and settled on the harsh world of Rax. In recent years, the divine herald Dhurus unified the jinsuls into a cohesive force known as the Jinsul Hierocracy, which briefly retook the Scoured Stars. A joint alliance between several species and members of the Starfinder Society defeated Dhurus and scattered the jinsuls back into the Vast.

With countless bases and fleets operating in deep space, jinsuls mostly act as raiders, scavenging for equipment and testing their mettle against other species. Indoctrinated to view themselves as a superior species, with only other inhabitants of the Scoured Stars having any value, jinsuls prefer to engage in short-ranged combat with their foes.

Jinsuls aren't numerous enough to fill every need on the many ships and starbases they control across the galaxy. Instead, they rely on robots and automated computer systems (always commanded by at least one jinsul officer) to keep their space stations running efficiently. These systems are programmed to be just as deadly and ruthless as jinsuls themselves; even the most innocuous automated system or robot, like a garbage collector, might wield deadly weapons or contain vicious technomagical countermeasures.

The people known as elindrians vanished eons ago into desolate husk-hives beneath the surface of the planet Castrovel. Until recently, they were creatures of legend, existing only in the most obscure formian histories. Now, scholars on Castrovel desperately search for additional records about elindrians, their origins, and—most importantly—the truth about their connection to the terrifying ooze-like creature that recently descended from their moon, Elindrae. One theory is that elindrians share some primal bond with the ooze-thing called the Terror of Ukulam, and perhaps both originate from Elindrae—other theories claim that elindrians created the ooze in the first place or that they're distant cousins to formians, corrupted by the Terror long ago.

虫群入侵时会部署斥候虫作为步兵。这些无畏而暴戾的生物对侦察星球环境与防御至关重要。单艘虫群飞船便可运载数千枚处于静滞状态的虫卵。

Developing far out in the Vast from an insectile species known as kucharns, the Swarm is considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of myriad component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and the Swarm's pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in its reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, its assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm is the direct ancestor of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标耳边响起蕴含星辰之外不可名状奥秘的不祥之音，使其神智混乱。目标需要尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功目标听到了诡异的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}，持续1轮。

items.name: 归乡梦
items.expectedDescription: You draw on a creature's thoughts of home and the comfort it finds in that concept, overwhelming the creature with wistful memories of whatever home means to it. The target must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the memories.
items.description: 你汲取生物对家的思念，以及它在这个概念中找到的慰藉，用任何代表家的思念记忆淹没生物。目标必须成功进行意志豁免，否则就会因这些记忆进入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 扭曲感知
items.expectedDescription: A wayward warp can sense creatures within their warp field as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 迷途空间扭曲能在所列范围以精确感官感知到其扭曲力场的生物。

items.name: 现实闪烁
items.expectedDescription: The wayward warp has concealment against attacks originating outside of their warp field.
items.description: 迷途空间扭曲对源自其扭曲力场外的攻击具有隐蔽。

gQIOCzsMtAP201XD.name: 防卫级安保机器人
gQIOCzsMtAP201XD.publicNotes:
这类安保机器人通常采用比其他机器人更耐用的材料制造，使其具备保护目标的能力。它们笨重的机身常被部署在重要人物或贵重物品周围，承担护卫职责。

Security robots are ubiquitous throughout industrialized space and have major presences in both the Pact Worlds and Veskarium, employed and customized by corporations and private citizens alike.

While most soldier robot models are built to be as destructive as possible, and elimination robots are designed to kill, security robots usually have fail-safes programmed into their behavior to prevent them from causing any more violence than is necessary to perform their designated security function. This makes them especially useful in cities, where unintended destruction might harm bystanders or cause legal issues, and even on starships, where a stray laser blast might cause serious damage to vital starship systems.

hYfUp7797H0Ltb3U.name: 蜥掠灵
hYfUp7797H0Ltb3U.publicNotes:
蜥掠蛸幼崽成群狩猎，以灰烬，金属，木头，甚至几乎一切物质维生。

Skreesires, and their offspring skreelings, are vicious predators who skulk and prowl in the crags and caverns of the cosmos.

items.name: 群聚攻击
items.expectedDescription: The skreeling's melee Strikes deal 1d4 persistent bleed damage to creatures within reach of one or more other skreelings.
items.description: 蜥掠灵的近战打击对处于一个或更多其他蜥掠灵触及范围内的生物造成1d4持续流血伤害。

ho2J4tE3WRoGMXUa.name: 巨刃霸主
ho2J4tE3WRoGMXUa.publicNotes:
作为重型突击部队而设计的巨刃霸主，能撕裂敌军阵型，在防御工事中开辟通道，为大批步兵部队扫清道路。从其前臂伸出的巨大刀刃不仅作为武器进化而来，更在巨刃霸主在接近至近战距离时，同时提供空气动力学支撑与少量防护。

Developing far out in the Vast from an insectile species known as kucharns, the Swarm is considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of myriad component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and the Swarm's pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in its reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, its assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm is the direct ancestor of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space.

items.name: 运动感知
items.expectedDescription: A thresher lord can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 虫群能在所列范围内以模糊感官通过空气或水中因生物移动产生的震动感知附近生物。

items.name: 虫群心智
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.
items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。

items.name: 切割现实
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。

items.name: 念动绞扼
items.expectedDescription: You telekinetically grasp a creature's throat or similar vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The first time each round you Sustain the spell, the target takes 1d12 bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized, and must continue holding its breath. The target can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the Escape DC is your spell DC, and the attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).
items.description: 你以精神力量牢牢扼住一个生物的咽喉或者类似重要生理结构，将其提起离地数寸，难以呼吸。尝试一次远程法术攻击对抗目标的AC，在命中时，你造成6d12钝击伤害，并且目标被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]。当以这种方式被禁足时，目标需要屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息（429页）。当你每轮第一次维持该法术时，目标都会再受到1d12持续钝击伤害并保持禁足，并需要继续屏住呼吸。目标可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]（逃脱DC为你的法术DC，并且逃脱的尝试会受到失能特征的影响）。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:

Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙之外，不可名状的力量，对区域内所有生物造成3d12心灵伤害，如同幻影尖爪、啃咬或是触须击中每个目标。区域中的每个生物都需要尝试一次意志豁免。区域对每个因该法术效果陷入恶心的生物都视为困难地形。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

大失败该生物受到两倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 岁月重担
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一束熵射线，迅速且无差别地分解物质。进行远程法术攻击对抗目标的AC。如果命中，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；或者如果目标生物有科技特征，则会受到2d6持续性酸蚀伤害并陷入故障1。如果重击，伤害翻倍，并且如果目标生物有科技特征，则陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

升阶 （+1）增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你可以用大量的精神信息或神圣审判使一个生物的精神超负荷。心灵冲击会造成2d6心灵伤害。在重击时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

i9GoDnoskQ5QZEgJ.name: 珊瑚怪
i9GoDnoskQ5QZEgJ.publicNotes: 小塔布里德的快速且鲁莽的工业化摧毁了这颗星球，尤其是严重破坏了科皮珊瑚（copi）——一种珊瑚，它是当地珊瑚人（copaxi）祖先的栖息地。然而，在科皮珊瑚与重力之间的魔法联系最强的区域，无处不在的污染反而将其变异成了怪异的新形态。在对珊瑚人进化的扭曲模仿中，成群的科皮珊瑚融合在一起，形成了珊瑚怪，一种由变异的科皮珊瑚与部分结晶垃圾形成的外壳融合而成的蹒跚巨物，它在移动时会发出嘎吱嘎吱的声响。珊瑚怪的形态不断变化，有时甚至会呈现出令人不安的类人特征，但这些特征很快又会消失。

iuovM4PRyAX0NwvI.name: 地狱骑士崩解使
iuovM4PRyAX0NwvI.publicNotes:
地狱骑士大部分人通常研究地狱之力来激发他们的战斗风格和魔法，但他们也可能学会与宇宙之力共鸣，从而成为恒星武士。

Hellknights are infernal knights, and while they once ruled entire nations on Lost Golarion, the Hellknights of the Pact Worlds enforce law and order more holistically, traveling in massive citadel starships to spread their influence rather than remaining in any one place. In battle, Hellknights are orderly, unrelenting, and deadly.

items.name: 引力子大砍刀
items.expectedDescription: A degradant wields a solar glaive formed of solidified gravitons. They can conjure and dismiss this weapon as a single action that has the concentrate trait. Whenever they successfully Strike a creature using their graviton glaive, the creature treats all squares adjacent to the square in which it was struck as difficult terrain until the end of the creature's next turn.
items.description: 崩解使持用一把由固化引力子组成的恒星大砍刀。他可以用一个具有专注特征的单动作来召唤或解消此武器。当他用自己的引力子大砍刀成功打击一个生物时，该生物将自己被击中时所处方格相邻的所有方格视作困难地形直到该生物的下个回合结束。

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检查时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.

jJ9OlkJVsoqRzmjM.name: 漂流尸聚合体
jJ9OlkJVsoqRzmjM.publicNotes:
聚合体是一群在他们破碎的灵魂残片操纵下融合为一体的漂流尸群。最初的聚合体是自然形成的，但尸骸舰队的血肉熔炉已能制造人工版本，这些生物被已在被部署在无数战场，作为突击部队活跃于前线。

Driftdead are created when a restless soul fuses with planar energies and reanimates its own corpse into a disturbing parody of life. Rarely, disturbed spirits snatched from elsewhere fuse together to inhabit a single dead body. Any death within the Drift might spawn a driftdead, but creatures that die in a frenzy of intense emotion are more likely to make the transition.

items.name: 撕离漂流域
items.expectedDescription: While outside the Drift, the amalgam gains the incorporeal trait, becomes immune to precision damage, and gains resistance 10 to all damage (except force, ghost killer, or spirit; double resistance vs. non-magical).
items.description: 在漂流域之外，聚合体获得虚体特征，免疫精准，并获得全部伤害 10抗力（除了力场，灭鬼，或精魂；对抗非魔法伤害抗力翻倍）

items.name: 燃烧棘刺
items.expectedDescription: A creature critically hit by a lumocantha's laser spine Strike takes an additional 1d4 persistent fire damage.
items.description: 被光棘花的激光棘刺重击的生物会额外受到1d4持续火焰伤害。

items.name: 原子能爆破
items.expectedDescription:
You magically split an atom, creating an explosion with radioactive fallout. All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the @Check[fortitude]{Fortitude DC} for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the initial damage.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes double damage.

成功目标受到一半伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1分钟。

失败目标受到全额伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1分钟。

大失败同失败，目标受到双倍伤害。

items.name: 火箭冲撞
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a rocket of flame from behind you and blast forward. You move in a straight line up to twice your Speed; you can move through spaces occupied by creatures, and the movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures in the area take 6d12 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 persistent fire damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. You reappear at the end of the line.

Heightened (+2) The fire damage increases by 2d12, and the persistent fire damage on a critical failure increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你向身后火箭喷射，极速向前冲刺。你直线移动两倍于你速度的距离，你可以穿过被生物占据的空间，并且这一移动不会触发反应。在区域内的生物受到6d12火焰伤害，这具有一次基础反射豁免。在大失败时，该生物还会额外受到2d6持续火焰伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1轮。你将重新出现在直线的终点。

升阶（+2）火焰伤害增加2d12，豁免大失败的持续火焰伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 等离子墙
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of crackling plasma that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of plasma in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of plasma with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The persistent electricity damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你塑造一面由劈啪作响的等离子体形成的墙壁，其会燃烧通过的生物。你创造一条5尺厚，至多60尺长10尺高的直线墙体，或者5尺厚，10尺半径，相同高度的环形墙体。不论哪种形式，墙体都垂直竖立。如果你愿意，墙体可以更短或者更矮。墙体两侧的任何物体对彼此都是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]的。任何试图穿过墙体或者在墙体占据区域内开始回合的生物受到4d6火焰伤害和2d6持续电击伤害。

升阶（+1）持续电击伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 菌丝网络
items.expectedDescription: Psychic fungi are connected to a network of psychic filaments bonding all psychic fungi from the same colony. This network grants the warden the ability to detect creatures capable of thought within 30 feet of a bonded psychic fungus up to 1,000 feet away as an imprecise sense.
items.description: 心能真菌与来自同一菌落的所有心能真菌之间，通过一个由心灵菌丝构成的网络相互连接。这一网络赋予采集者一种模糊感官，使其能够探测到距离相互联结的心能真菌30尺以内、且距离自身最远可达1000尺的具有思维能力的生物。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

jrL6wPYmf7orkM64.name: 异星卫士新兵
jrL6wPYmf7orkM64.publicNotes:
绿卫士是异星卫士中的精英战斗部队，以自然魔法著称，常被派往发生生态剧变的地点。新加入绿卫士的成员被授予“根”（root）的军衔，但通常被称为“新兵”（greenhorns）。异星卫士新兵在紧密团结的小队中接受全面的训练。

The Xenowardens are a powerful and well-respected organization who aim to safeguard and study the natural world and ensure that technological advances are ecologically responsible. With an incredibly diverse membership, their ranks include, among others, hermits who practice nature magic and eschew technology and scientists who create renewable energy from algae. On the other end of the spectrum are elite combat units like the Wildknights and the Greenguards and feared ecoterrorists like the enigmatic Oleander. The Xenowardens are led by a Greenspeaker, who's elected by acclaim and advised by their peers.

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 共同生长
items.expectedDescription: A Xenowarden greenhorn's AC increases by +1 when they're within reach of at least one other Xenowarden greenhorn.
items.description: 当异星卫士新兵处于至少一名其他异星卫士新兵的触及范围内时，其AC增加1。

items.name: 数字现实
items.expectedDescription: 60 feet. Within the aura, everything looks digitalized. Visible creatures in the aura can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and invisible creatures are concealed rather than undetected.
items.description: （灵光，视觉）60尺。在灵光之内，一切看上去都是数字化的。灵光内的可见生物不能变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]，且隐形生物会成为隐蔽而非无踪。

jvS1S3iGtj5uxadI.name: 异星卫士根誓者
jvS1S3iGtj5uxadI.publicNotes:
异星卫士根誓者是导师和教导者，负责监督并指挥一个根系小队（a platoon of roots）的训练与作战。大多数根誓者都是才华横溢的施法者，能够操控植物，利用它们保护异星卫士免受伤害，并在战场上部署盟友。

items.name: 音波尖啸
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a painfully rapid cone of vibrations by letting out a cathartic scream, dealing 1d8 sonic damage to creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage by 1d8.
items.description:
你发出一声宣泄性的痛苦尖啸，释放锥形的振动波，对区域内的生物造成1d8音波伤害，这具有基础强韧豁免。豁免失败的生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d8

items.name: 事件视界
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash the power of a supermassive black hole. All creatures in the area take 6d10 bludgeoning and 6d10 void damage. Event horizon ignores up to 10 resistance creatures in the area have to bludgeoning, and up to 10 resistance they have to void. Each creature attempts a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3} until the end of its next turn, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你释放出超大黑洞的力量。区域内的所有生物都会受到6d10钝击伤害和6d10虚能伤害。事件视界可无视区域内生物最多10点钝击抗力与最多10点虚能抗力。每个生物都尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}直到他的下个回合结束。

失败该生物受到全额伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 3}直到他的下个回合结束，在接下来陷入持续1分钟的缓慢1。

大失败该生物受到双倍伤害并陷入缓慢3直到他的下个回合结束，在接下来陷入持续1分钟的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 2}。
