items.name: 呼召宇宙
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the void and call down a vertical column of dangerous cosmic material that rains destruction upon creatures in the area and shrouds the terrain around it in a swirl of stardust. This matter is made up of bits of burning stars and chunks of frozen comets, and it deals 5d12 cold damage and 5d12 fire damage to every creature in the area when you Cast the Spell. For the spell's duration, the cosmic material reduces visibility and mobility, making the area greater difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Heightened (10th) The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.
items.description:
你探入虚空并召来一片危险的宇宙物质，其在一个垂直圆柱内摧毁其中生物，并将地形化为星尘漩涡。这种物质由燃烧的恒星或冰冻的彗星组成，对施法时区域内的所有生物造成5d12火焰伤害和5d12寒冷伤害。在法术持续期间内，宇宙物质降低了能见度和机动性，使该区域内变为高等困难地形并且让该区域内或者透过其的所有事物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

升阶（10环）寒冷伤害和火焰伤害各增加2d12。

items.expectedDescription:
You flash freeze a target then send subsonic waves through it, potentially reducing it into fine powder. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit a target, the target takes 6d8 cold damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolled on its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by further damage.

Success The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level -3)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Critical Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level +6)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The cold and sonic damage each increase by 1d8.
items.description:
你会瞬间冻结一个目标，然后向其发送亚音速波，有可能将其变成粉末。对目标发动法术攻击。如果你击中目标，则目标会受到6d8点寒冷伤害，并必须尝试一次强韧豁免。如果你的法术攻击造成重击，目标的强韧豁免结果会下降一级成功度。减至0HP的生物会被炸成粉末，但其装备会保留。

大成功目标不受进一步伤害的影响。

Success The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level -3)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Critical Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level +6)d8)[sonic]] damage.

升阶（+1）寒冷和音波伤害增加1d8

items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。

items.expectedDescription:
You take control of a technological creature or object and command it telepathically. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order to a sapient target, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the controlled condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if it's sapient and you give it a new order that's against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你可以控制一个科技特征的生物或物体，并以心灵感应的方式命令它。如果你向有生命的目标发出明显的自毁命令，该目标在你发出新命令之前不会行动。效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标因为要抵抗你的命令而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

失败你控制了目标。目标将获得被控制状态，但可以在每个回合结束时尝试意志豁免。成功后，法术结束。

大失败与失败相同，但只有智慧目标，并且你给它下达了违背其本性的新命令（例如杀死它的盟友）时，才能进行新的意志豁免。

升阶（10阶）持续时间不受限制。

items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 突变形态
items.expectedDescription: The illumantula is a grouping of tiny tech bits that project energy between themselves, though the illumantula functions as single creature. The illumantula's size gives its space while being fully dispersed, though it can take actions to change its size. The illumantula can occupy the same space as other creatures and must do so to use some of its actions.
items.description: 辉耀狼蛛是由众多微小的科技组件构成的几何体，这些组件在彼此间传递能量，尽管辉耀狼蛛视作单一生物。当完全分散时，辉耀狼蛛的体型决定了它占据的空间，不过它可以使用动作来改变体型。辉耀狼蛛可以与其他生物占据相同空间，且必须如此做才能使用其部分动作。

items.name: 现实力场
items.expectedDescription: Creatures sharing a space with the illumantula can't use any actions or abilities with the fortune trait. A creature beginning its turn within the illumantula's space can't use actions or ability with the fortune trait until the end of their turn. The illumantula has weakness 10 against any ability or action affected by the fortune trait that successfully damages it.
items.description: 与辉耀狼蛛共享空间的生物无法使用任何具有幸运特征的动作或能力。在辉耀狼蛛所处空间内开始回合的生物，无法使用具有幸运特征的动作或能力直到其回合结束。辉耀狼蛛对任何受幸运特征影响且对其造成伤害的动作或能力具有弱点10。

items.name: 虚妄引擎
items.expectedDescription: When the illumantula scores a critical hit with a transreality beam Strike, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}, or increases its doomed value by 1 if it was already doomed.
items.description: 辉耀狼蛛以跨现实光束打击造成重击时，目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 Doomed 1}，或是在其已经处于毁灭状态时提升其1点毁灭状态值。

items.name: 呼召宇宙
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the void and call down a vertical column of dangerous cosmic material that rains destruction upon creatures in the area and shrouds the terrain around it in a swirl of stardust. This matter is made up of bits of burning stars and chunks of frozen comets, and it deals 5d12 cold damage and 5d12 fire damage to every creature in the area when you Cast the Spell. For the spell's duration, the cosmic material reduces visibility and mobility, making the area greater difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Heightened (10th) The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.
items.description:
你探入虚空并召来一片危险的宇宙物质，其在一个垂直圆柱内摧毁其中生物，并将地形化为星尘漩涡。这种物质由燃烧的恒星或冰冻的彗星组成，对施法时区域内的所有生物造成5d12火焰伤害和5d12寒冷伤害。在法术持续期间内，宇宙物质降低了能见度和机动性，使该区域内变为高等困难地形并且让该区域内或者透过其的所有事物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

升阶（10环）寒冷伤害和火焰伤害各增加2d12。

items.name: 播种奇点
items.expectedDescription:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity.

Failure The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the singularity.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the singularity.

items.name: X光视域
items.expectedDescription: You empower yourself to see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white.
items.description: 你激活透视能力，可看穿60尺内大多数材质与墙体。你的视线会被2尺厚的木材或塑料，1尺厚的岩石，2寸厚的普通金属或者任意厚度的铅或星金阻隔，并且你的视野为黑白的。

items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 魅影舰队
items.expectedDescription: A menacing vision of a fleet of hostile starships fills the mind of each creature in the area. The ships appear to be 1,000 feet overhead bombarding the ground with laser fire. The vision deals 10d8 mental damage with a basic Will save. On a critical failure, the target also believes it's being pursued and moves to take cover. It must spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} on each of its turns, which may require it to first move to a new space or Drop Prone. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the phantasm and stops being forced to Take Cover.
items.description: 该区域内的每只生物脑海中都会浮现出敌对星舰舰队的可怕景象。这些飞船看起来就在头顶上 1,000 英尺处，会用激光炮火轰击地面。该幻象会造成10d8心灵伤害，需要进行基础意志豁免。如果大失败，目标会认为自己被追击，并移动躲避。他必须在每个回合都花费一个动作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]，这意味着他必须使用第一个动作移动到一个新空间或执行趴下（Drop Prone）动作。他可以在每个回合结束时尝试新的意志豁免，如果成功，目标就会识破幻象，并停止逃跑或畏缩。

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应的方式与一个生物分享痛苦的感觉。目标受到3d12精神伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环）该法术最多可瞄准四个生物，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

你可以用大量的精神信息或神圣审判使一个生物的精神超负荷。心灵冲击会造成2d6心灵伤害。在重击时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1轮。

l02q2ZmGsBNX4zHx.name: 闪晶石哨兵
l02q2ZmGsBNX4zHx.publicNotes: 作为强大的守护构装体，闪晶石哨兵能够操控并吸收情感，将敌人的情绪反而作为自身的武器加以利用。它们由闪晶石铸造而成——这种具有共情能力的矿物开采自维斯克八号行星，天然具备平复周围生灵情绪的特性。闪晶石哨兵可汲取强烈的情绪能量，并将其注入自身躯体，从而强化攻击威力。

items.name: 情绪感知
items.expectedDescription: A shimmerstone sentinel can sense the emotions of creatures within the listed range as an imprecise sense. Emotion sense is a precise sense against creatures under an emotion effect. A creature under the effects of calm can't be noticed via emotion sense.
items.description: （情绪，心灵）闪晶石哨兵能以模糊感官察觉到所列范围内生物的情绪。若目标生物正处于情绪效果影响下，情绪感知则成为精确感官。但处于安定心神（Calm）效果影响下的生物，无法通过情绪感知被察觉。

items.name: 生命容器
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.

触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.

一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 过热术
items.expectedDescription:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6. Increase the damage of touching affected objects by 3.

items.name: 重填武器
items.expectedDescription:
You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its expend until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less.

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.
items.description:
你触碰一件没有剩余弹药的武器，用魔法能量为其充能。直到你的下一回合结束时，目标会获得与其“耗弹”相等的弹药或充能，并允许任何持有目标的人使用该武器进行一次打击。该法术只能为使用弹药且弹药价格不超过10个信用点的武器充能。

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.

items.name: 机械诡计
items.expectedDescription: When a clangit has spent at least 1 hour exploring a ship or space station, the gremlin gains an innate sense of its inner workings and can remotely control mechanical infrastructure within 60 feet, performing simple actions such as opening and shutting airlocks and doors, opening heat vents, activating alarms, turning lights on and off, or tampering with gravity controls.
items.description: 当空间站小魔怪花费至少1小时在星舰或空间站内探索时，小魔怪便能洞悉其内部运作机制，可以在60尺内远程操控机械设施，执行诸如开启关闭气闸与舱门、开启散热口、启动警报、开关照明设备或干扰重力控制系统等简单操作。

lkJueMjiDaLp7owG.name: 幼年羚豹
lkJueMjiDaLp7owG.publicNotes:
幼年羚豹会聚集在一起形成“幼兽群”（glarings）。它们在出生几天后就会被母兽遗弃，随后会被一头成年羚豹收养，由这头成年兽将它们养大。

Those traveling through Akiton's Winterlands risk stumbling on its apex predator: the carnivorous arabuk.

items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 自毁协议
items.expectedDescription: The circuitry of an assassin robot self-destructs upon the robot's destruction, making tracing its owner extremely difficult. Add 10 to the DC of a Computers check to recover data from a destroyed assassin robot.
items.description: 当刺客机器人被摧毁时，其电路系统将自动触发自毁程序，这使得追踪其所有者变得极其困难。从被摧毁的刺客机器人中恢复数据时，计算机检定的DC需额外增加10点。

items.name: 伪装外壳
items.expectedDescription: The demolition-class assassin robot enters or leaves its disguised form. While in its disguised form, it loses the ability to make Strikes or use its Breaching Rush ability, but it becomes indistinguishable from a noncombatant robot or drone model that it's based on; it gets an automatic result of 33 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a robot of that model. Damage to the robot can prevent this disguise from being effective at the GM's discretion.
items.description: 轰杀级刺客机器人可启动或解除伪装形态。处于伪装形态时，它将失去打击和突击能力的效果，但与它所伪装的非战斗机器人或无人机型号没有分别；在伪装成该型号机器人时，他的欺骗检定结果和欺骗DC自动取33点。在GM的裁定下 ，对刺客机器人造成伤害可能使它的伪装失效。

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标耳边响起蕴含星辰之外不可名状奥秘的不祥之音，使其神智混乱。目标需要尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

失败目标开始漫无目的地游荡，使用每个动作来快步（方向随机）。当其移动时，其会采取最安全的路线并且不会进入有害地形。法术会持续1分钟或者直到目标被敌对动作瞄准。

neRhNGqn4SL5bV8u.name: 月巨人
neRhNGqn4SL5bV8u.publicNotes:
月巨人是体型最大的类人生物之一，站立时约24尺高。他们的体重因地域差异显著，随着环绕当前位置的卫星天体数量增加而增长，但这种特性似乎从未影响过他们的行动能力。月巨人们大多冷静且性情平和，但月相变化与天象异变极易影响其情绪，任何接近者都应先观测星象。这些巨人常担任先知，接受朝圣者的馈赠或祭品以换取服务。

Critical Success The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

Heightened (10th) The resistance increases to 20, and the damage dealt by the attacks increases to 4d6.
items.description:
你目标的肌肤化为坚固的石头甲壳，赋予对物理伤害的5点抗力，精金除外。目标获得拳头无武装攻击，造成2d6点钝击伤害。目标为此使用其最高的武器或无武装攻击熟练度，并且如果其具有武器专精或高等武器专精，其也可以应用此额外伤害。在使用此无武装攻击重击时，被重击生物必须成功通过一次强韧豁免，对抗目标的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}，持续1轮。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.v724q5Xi7KPPnLQ3]

升阶（6环）抗力提升至10，无武装攻击造成的伤害提升至3d6。

升阶（10环）抗力提升至20，无武装攻击造成的伤害提升至4d6。

items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 虚无噬咬
items.expectedDescription: The veolisk makes a jaws Strike against a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} creature, which gains the deadly d10 trait. If the target attempts the flat check to recover from its confusion when it takes damage from this Strike, it rolls twice and takes the lower result.
items.description: （厄运） 虚化蜥蜴对一个处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]状态的目标进行一次颚打击，此次打击获得致命d10特征。如果目标因此次打击的伤害而尝试纯骰检定以从困惑状态中恢复，它掷骰两次并采用较差的结果。

oilbk9sgGQC0u0um.name: 惑心小魔怪
oilbk9sgGQC0u0um.publicNotes:
许多不幸遭遇惑心小魔怪的可怜人往往为时已晚才惊觉。这些小魔怪沉迷于观看其他生物遭受屈辱性失败，常耗费数周甚至更长时间精心挑选并培养受害者，最终引诱其走向自我毁灭。他们先通过读取目标心灵，探知对方最渴望的事物，继而施展幻术伪装成仙女教母或类似的愿望实现者，诱使受害者相信自己肩负伟大使命。他们送上神奇“礼物”，不断怂恿目标追求更宏大的野心。然而当小魔怪认定受害者陷入足够狼狈或危险的境地时，便会将这份馈赠扭曲成可怕的诅咒。

Gremlins have plagued the Universe with cruel tricks since long before the Gap, and they've fully adapted to a galaxy filled with technology. Whether meddling with a comm unit, a starship, or an entire space station, gremlins delight in ruination and chaos.

items.name: 刺激细胞
items.expectedDescription:
You vitalize and stimulate the target at a cellular level, giving it a temporary burst of energy that unfortunately takes an exhausting toll. The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action to Stride or Strike. After that round ends, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until it can rest for 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.
items.description:
你从细胞层面激发目标的活力，使其获得短暂的能量爆发，但不幸的是，这将使其精疲力竭。目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]状态，并可以使用额外的行动行走或打击。该轮结束后，目标会变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]，直到休息10分钟。

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 回旋弹
items.expectedDescription:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一道由闪烁钢铁构成的旋转圆盘或光滑球体在目标之间弹射跃动。造成2d4钝击或挥砍伤害，需要进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。

ooZMSCAd3OyfyXOe.name: 相位兽
ooZMSCAd3OyfyXOe.publicNotes:
成年相位兽仅在交配和抚育新孵化的幼崽时结伴成对，在此期间它们会将领地边界视为共享区域——其余时间它们极具领地意识。

Incredibly ferocious, nyssholoras are dinosaur-like creatures that number among the most dangerous and feared apex predators on the planet of Castrovel. These walking weapons brandish lethal biology: a massive maw lined with twin rows of razor-sharp teeth, scythe-shaped phasic blade forearms that vibrate at ultrasonic speeds, and a scourge-like tail capable of absorbing electricity from the surrounding atmosphere. Yet, nyssholoras are also cunning and perceptive—a frill of tentacles that crowns their head detect telepathic signals, making it impossible for the local formians and lashuntas to escape their notice. Their phasic blades can cut through walls and vehicles as easily as underbrush, ensuring prey have nowhere safe to hide.

items.name: 心灵感应感知
items.expectedDescription: A nyssholora senses all creatures that have telepathy, limited telepathy, or a similar ability, such as a mystic's bond, as an imprecise sense at the listed range. This sense works through walls and other obstacles.
items.description: （原能） 相位兽能感知拥有心灵感应，有限心灵感应或类似能力的所有生物，例如秘术师的纽带，作为一种具有所列范围的模糊感官。此感官能够穿透墙壁和其他障碍物。

items.name: 相位打击
items.expectedDescription: A nyssholora's phasic blade Strike treats any object or construct it hits as if the target had half as much Hardness as usual.
items.description: 相位兽的相位刃打击将被其命中的任何物体或构装体视作硬度比通常情况减半。

p87ZL2JDCT0nuhrP.name: 生物科技巨人
p87ZL2JDCT0nuhrP.publicNotes:
漫长的岁月里，这些巨人穿越星海寻找家园。当他们在浩界探索潜在的新家园时，却被一种奇异的真菌侵袭，凡是被其触及之物皆遭吞噬。巨人的体型使他们免于立即灭亡，但大多数人只能眼睁睁看着菌丝的蓝绿色触须覆盖他们的新家园。绝望中，巨人倾尽所有资源投入科学研究，试图根除真菌。然而他们最终学会了适应。巨人们开始与真菌共生，将其嫁接到皮肤上，融入自身科技中。如今，这些巨人以科学家和生态系统守护者的身份探索星系。虽然他们大多为其他物种提供其科学专业，但一个名为“孢子行者”（sporerunners）的冒险家群体正日益壮大，他们深入星系最危险的区域，踏上寻找他们称之为家的行星的征程。

Giants are enormous humanoids of many varieties who live all across the galaxy.

items.name: 专家级神射手
items.expectedDescription: The jygyk doubles the range increment of weapons in the sniper weapon group they wield. If they're ever unarmed or out of ammunition, they can Interact to create an tactical weapon in the sniper weapon group or 30 projectiles.
items.description: 恨念魔在使用狙击武器组中的武器时，其武器的射程增量翻倍。如果恨念魔处于无武装或弹药耗尽的状态，它可以通过一次交互动作，制造出一件属于狙击武器组的战术型武器，或制造出 30 发射弹弹药。

items.name: 尖刺转移
items.expectedDescription: A warp troll's phasic spikes shift out of reality until they reach their target, ignoring circumstance bonuses to the target's AC granted by cover.
items.description: 穿界巨魔的相位尖刺脱离现实直到抵达其目标，忽略目标从掩蔽中获得的AC环境加值。

pjh2PB4JwYlgMTwj.name: 蓝藻灵
pjh2PB4JwYlgMTwj.publicNotes:
这些木元素生物虽拥有啮齿类动物的可爱外形，但其主体却由产毒藻类构成。蓝藻灵在任何温暖潮湿的环境中都能大量繁殖。它们形成的藻华非常显眼：远远看去，就像静止水面上漂浮的蓝绿色草甸，或者附着在植物和岩石上的毛茸茸青蓝色苔藓。如果冒险者被这壮观的景象吸引，贸然靠近水边或伸手触摸那些柔软绚丽的苔藓，便可能惊动这些美丽却致命的生物。

Elementals are energetic intrusions from the primal planes of existence. They take many forms, from mindless eddies in the wind or water to complex entities capable of wielding primal magic. The advent of space travel and the progress of technology have allowed even more living embodiments of the elements to manifest in the Universe.

Natural events like wildfires, solar storms, and floods can unleash hordes of unruly elementals on a planet or into a region of space. Sometimes, a gathering of powerful elementals causes a natural disaster on an epic scale, like an off-the-charts solar flare that fries a planet's power grid or a ceaseless storm swirling in a gas giant's atmosphere.

items.name: 水体感知
items.expectedDescription: A cyanoscum can sense the presence of water within 60 feet as an imprecise sense.
items.description: 蓝藻灵能以模糊感官，感知60尺范围内的水体存在。

items.name: 柔软躯体
items.expectedDescription: A cyanoscum can Squeeze through spaces that aren't airtight at its Speed per round.
items.description: 蓝藻灵每轮能以自身速度挤入任何非完全封闭的狭窄空间。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙之外，不可名状的力量，对区域内所有生物造成3d12心灵伤害，如同幻影尖爪、啃咬或是触须击中每个目标。区域中的每个生物都需要尝试一次意志豁免。区域对每个因该法术效果陷入恶心的生物都视为困难地形。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

大失败该生物受到两倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 岁月重担
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检查时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 正义大炮
items.expectedDescription: An arqsheth can be the target of spells that can target a ranged weapon, such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.SbBqa1HStMrV47fb], while wielded by another creature.
items.description: 当阿克谢斯被其他生物当作武器使用时，它可以被那些影响远程武器的法术（如“@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.SbBqa1HStMrV47fb]”）作为目标。

rVOhPNjG0BgPCeEI.name: 错字魔（谬误邪魔）
rVOhPNjG0BgPCeEI.publicNotes:
这些体型如孩童般的邪魔，象征着因听写错误、抄写失误或文本复制粘贴出错而导致的死亡恐怖。谬误邪魔会悄然篡改文本：替换某个词汇、添加一个嘲讽的表情符号，或调整标点符号，从而赋予书面文字完全不同的含义。这些细微改动往往引发冲突，而谬误邪魔正是在这些因简单错误引发的纷争与潜在死亡中茁壮成长。

Hailing from the plane of Abaddon, daemons are utterly devoted to the destruction of all life. Their existence is based around specific means of death, and they seek the death of all things in service to their lords: the Apocalypse Riders. Each daemon represents a different way to die, and they use their specific powers to further that means of death.

Advents in technology have only created new means of death and torment, so new types of daemons enter existence with regularity, each created once a sufficient mass of new deaths occurs to spawn them. These new advent daemons often prefer to spend their time in the galaxy rather than Abaddon, as they can better spread their torments to the mortals of creation.

items.name: 计算机交谈
items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你可以向居住在电脑中的精魂提问，并从他们那里得到答案。这些合成灵魂会在计算机代码中显现，通常会因设备的性质、状态、应用和个性化设置而具有不同的个性。计算机的视角、感官和知识使它的世界观与人类的世界观大相径庭，以至于它认为某些细节并不重要。计算机能回答的大多数问题都与过去曾与它们互动的生物有关，还有它们的文件中隐藏的信息。

升阶（6环）持续时间8小时。

items.name: 瞬效病毒
items.expectedDescription:
Your touch installs a dangerous self-replicating virus that disrupts a technological creature's programming. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Failure The target is glitching 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.
items.description:
你通过接触安装一种危险的自增殖病毒，会扰乱科技生物的程序。目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]。

失败目标陷入故障1和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

大失败目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 2}。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

The creature who owns the target comm unit regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell, a +5-foot status bonus to all Speeds, and a +1 status bonus to saves against fear effects for the duration as long as the comm unit continues to play the ringtone.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.NmhqKZyMgQSHbyHj]

items.description:
你会让目标通讯装置播放一首宇宙编曲的、专属于其拥有者的个人主题曲。当你施放该法术时，拥有该目标通讯单元的生物会恢复 1d8+4生命值，所有速度获得+5尺状态加值，并且在持续时间内，只要通讯单元继续播放铃声，对恐惧效果的豁免就会获得 +1状态加值。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 管理员视觉
items.expectedDescription: An emvermod can sense items and creatures with active accounts on any community they moderate as an imprecise sense at the listed range. They recognize community members, even if they use an infosphere alias.
items.description: 网管精能感知到在其管理的任何社区中拥有活跃账户的物品和生物，这是一种指定范围内的模糊感官。它们能识别出社区成员，即使这些成员使用了信息圈别名。

items.name: 害羞
items.expectedDescription: An emvermod is naturally invisible while holding a comm unit or in a virtual space. They don't appear to have an account in any infosphere space they moderate. They can become visible, or even selectively visible, allowing only specific people to see them.
items.description: 网管精在持有通讯单元或处于虚拟空间时，自然处于隐形状态。在任何它们所管理的信息圈空间中，它们似乎都没有账户。它们可以显形，甚至可以选择性地显形，只允许特定的人看到它们。

rl5p1LLCpKh16viU.name: 维修级安保机器人
rl5p1LLCpKh16viU.publicNotes:
在许多简陋的星舰与偏远的太空站中，部署专用安保机器人往往成本过高——尤其是当这些设施根本无法获得安保机器人使用许可时。此类运营方通常依赖廉价的维护机器人来应对入侵者：虽然它们可能无力对抗严重威胁，但至少能在常见害虫（如老鼠、昆虫等）破坏星舰电路前将其清除。毕竟，有时最好的维护就是预防性维护。

Security robots are ubiquitous throughout industrialized space and have major presences in both the Pact Worlds and Veskarium, employed and customized by corporations and private citizens alike.

While most soldier robot models are built to be as destructive as possible, and elimination robots are designed to kill, security robots usually have fail-safes programmed into their behavior to prevent them from causing any more violence than is necessary to perform their designated security function. This makes them especially useful in cities, where unintended destruction might harm bystanders or cause legal issues, and even on starships, where a stray laser blast might cause serious damage to vital starship systems.

sJaEEl0DzV9iQfVW.name: 幽噬怪博学者
sJaEEl0DzV9iQfVW.publicNotes:
这些幽噬怪已经活了数个世纪，体型超过15尺高，1000磅重。幽噬怪博学者们花费了多年时间折磨和撕裂它们遇到的所有生物，并且它们对大量种类生物的解剖结构有着丰厚的知识。它们比年轻的幽噬怪更加残忍，在偷取受害者的生命力之前，它们以给受害者带来极度痛苦为乐。它们比年轻的同类在漂流域中旅行得更远，被它们寻找和解剖新生物的无尽欲望所驱使。

The Drift is a strange place, and the creatures native to it are stranger still. Garaggakals prove no exception. Shaped vaguely like humanoids, they have arms and legs but also sallow, rubbery skin with long, scaly tails and gauzelike wings. Most horrifyingly, their faces are almost entirely taken up by their enormous, funnel-like mouth, lined with sharp teeth. While they use these mouths for the obvious purpose of biting, they can also use its powerful suction to draw actual life force from their prey.

Also known as "Drift wraiths," garaggakals hunt down any living creatures that linger too long in the Drift. For garaggakals, anything that isn't a fellow garaggakal is prey. However, they're no mere mindless hunters. Garaggakals are surprisingly intelligent and prefer to dissect victims, learning all about them before eating them. Often, garaggakals take their victims apart while they're still alive. Xenobiologists have determined that garaggakals don't even technically need to eat to survive, so their relentless hunger is seemingly psychological. They do require the energy of the Drift to survive in the absence of food, however, and further need the energy of the Drift to reproduce, seeking out areas of intense radiation to absorb and then build a new offspring from their own cells. Their children are fully grown at creation.

Garaggakals surprise their prey. They are quite stealthy and can even phase through solid matter, suddenly appearing on the inside of a starship—bad news for whatever living creatures happen to be inside. Con artists sell garaggakal repelling devices for travelers to use while in the Drift to prevent such visits.

items.name: 情绪感知
items.expectedDescription: The garaggakal polymath senses all creatures that are under emotion effects as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: （情绪，心灵，异能） 幽噬怪能在所列范围内以模糊感官感知到所有受情绪效果影响的生物。

items.name: 感知思维
items.expectedDescription: The garaggakal's imprecise senses function through most materials and walls. The senses are blocked by energy fields (such as force fields and force effects) and sufficiently dense material: 10 feet of wood or plastic, 5 feet of stone, 1 foot of common metal, or 6 inches of lead or any starmetal.
items.description: 幽噬怪的模糊感官能穿透大多数材料和墙体生效。这些感官能被能量场（例如力场护盾和力场效果）以及足够致密的材料阻挡：10尺木材或塑料，5尺石头，1尺常见金属，或者6英寸厚的铅或任何星金。

items.name: 白骨追猎者
items.expectedDescription: A crest-eater can use its scent as a precise sense at the listed range against creatures that have taken damage from crest-eater venom in the past hour.
items.description: 对于过去一小时内受到噬冠兽毒液伤害的生物，噬冠兽可以在指定范围内使用气味作为精确感官。

items.name: 乱石行者
items.expectedDescription: Crest-eaters ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble, sand, and uneven ground made of earth and stone.
items.description: 噬冠兽忽视由碎石、沙地及由土石构成的不稳地面所形成的困难地形。

sl3T1TpAX6LWR1OO.name: 自由船长
sl3T1TpAX6LWR1OO.publicNotes:
船长是任何船上的最高位阶。他们仅向自由船长们的海军上将负责，且仅限于其舰船未参与交战时。这位船长默认使用弯刀的虚能模式，刀刃上数百颗闪烁的星辰，象征着她在无数战斗中夺取的生命。

The Free Captains have been a scourge of interstellar shipping across the Pact Worlds for generations, but since the adoption of Drift Lanes, the outlaws have expanded their reach and scale by targeting ships across the galaxy using the new standardized interstellar shipping routes.

items.name: 绝不手软！
items.expectedDescription: The Free Captain telepathically orders their crew to mercilessly slaughter one target. All allied creatures of equal or lower level within 60 feet of the Free Captain gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls against one creature until the end of the Free Captain's next turn.
items.description: （专注，情绪，语言，心灵） 自由船长以心灵感应命令船员无情宰杀一个目标。在自由船长60尺范围内，所有等级相等或较低的盟友生物对该生物进行的攻击掷骰和伤害掷骰上获得+1状态加值，直到自由船长的下个回合结束。

t293r8NAroe7Vcvn.name: 荒芜龙兽
t293r8NAroe7Vcvn.publicNotes:
荒芜龙兽因恶臭和污染而在龙类生物中恶名昭彰。它们用堪比最恶劣的工业化产物的污秽与腐朽来污染周遭的空气。这些独居的怪物形似栖息于沼泽的龙类近亲，但其周身时常笼罩着一层令人窒息的浓厚瘴气。荒芜龙兽以污染洁净青翠的环境为乐，所过之处都会留下永久的污秽痕迹。

Drakes resemble their larger draconic cousins in more than just scaled, monstrous acclaim. Ranging in size from the diminutive fey drake to the massive, ship-sized star drake, drakes share a dragons' winged reptilian form, long necks, and breath weapons. But where dragons often have forelimbs and wings, a drake typically only has one or the other. Their long, winding tails and sharp jaws more than make up for this lack, however.

Despite being more animalistic than dragons, drakes still possess a formidable cunning, and most share a dragon's ability to generate some form of breath weapon. However, their lack of intelligence makes drakes substantially easier to domesticate than other draconic creatures, and their familial nature makes them excellent pack hunters.

items.name: 龙之狂怒
items.expectedDescription: The drake makes two jaws Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.
items.description: 荒芜龙兽以任意顺序作出2次下颚打击和1次尾巴打击。

items.name: 电缆感知
items.expectedDescription: A tregalxi can sense the presence of electrical wires within 30 feet as an imprecise sense.
items.description: 聚缆球能以模糊感官感知到30尺内的电缆。

items.name: 绝缘外壳
items.expectedDescription: When a tregalxi is reduced to less than half their Hit Points, their insulated wire shell breaks, freeing their contained radiation. All electricity damage dealt by the tregalxi instead becomes poison damage. When a creature takes poison damage from a tregalxi, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 minute with no way to reduce the condition.
items.description: 当聚缆球的生命值被降至一半以下时，其绝缘线缆外壳会破裂，释放出内部封存的辐射。此后，聚缆球造成的所有电击伤害将转变为毒素伤害。任何生物受到来自聚缆球的毒素伤害时，会陷入持续1分钟的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}状态，且此状态无法被减轻。

tNC4Vpe6qgGSdbcP.name: 干扰虫群
tNC4Vpe6qgGSdbcP.publicNotes:
单只干扰虫的震动会导致轻微的眩晕，但当这些微小的甲虫状子体协同时，其引发的大气扰动将使绝大多数通讯方式失效。干扰虫通常栖息于行星的荒芜孤寂之地，得以不受阻碍地繁衍。它们的存在预示着虫群全面入侵的降临。

Developing far out in the Vast from an insectile species known as kucharns, the Swarm is considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of myriad component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and the Swarm's pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in its reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, its assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm is the direct ancestor of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space.

items.name: 运动感知
items.expectedDescription: An szynegator swarm can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 虫群能在所列范围内以模糊感官通过空气或水中因生物移动产生的震动感知附近生物。

items.name: 虫群心智
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.
items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。

items.name: 通讯阻断
items.expectedDescription: 40 feet. All electronic and telepathic communication, except for that with the colony mind ability, ceases to function, and affected creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks. When three or more szynegator swarms are aware of each other using colony mind, the range of comm occlusion increases to 100 feet. This range increases to planetary when 10 or more szynegator swarms are aware of each other using colony mind.
items.description: （灵光） 40尺。除了虫群心智能力外，所有电子与心灵通讯停止生效，并且受影响的生物在察觉检定上承受-2环境减值。当3支或更多干扰虫群通过虫群心智意识到彼此时，通讯阻断的范围提升至100尺。当10支或更多干扰虫群通过虫群心智意识到彼此时，此范围提升至行星范围。

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检查时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.

tq09xtM8zptdwx50.name: 堡垒虫
tq09xtM8zptdwx50.publicNotes:
令人畏惧的堡垒虫是生物有机体壁垒，它们利用巨大的甲壳质盾牌抵挡伤害，同时向敌人释放生物电束。它们为克雷西斯卡子群的推进部队，例如成群结队的灵巧钻地虫，提供阵地掩护。这些生物巨兽不过是克雷西斯卡子群部队中众多创新之一，曾在罗德纳斯（Rodnarth）围城战中活跃，当时它们毫不留情地穿越了该星球险恶的沼泽地带。

items.name: 运动感知
items.expectedDescription: A bastorox can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 虫群能在所列范围内以模糊感官通过空气或水中因生物移动产生的震动感知附近生物。

items.name: 虫群心智
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.
items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。

items.name: 盾臂
items.expectedDescription: A bastorox's battering arm can also be used as a shield (Hardness 5, 30 HP, BT 15). If the shield is destroyed, the bastorox takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls made with its battering arm Strikes. A destroyed shield arm regenerates over the course of 24 hours.
items.description: 堡垒虫的粉碎臂可以用作盾牌（硬度5，30 HP，15 BT）。如果盾牌被摧毁，堡垒虫在使用粉碎臂进行打击的攻击掷骰上承受-2环境减值。被摧毁的盾臂会经过24小时后再生。

uVg2tbY8lbG2CJd8.name: 心能真菌采集者
uVg2tbY8lbG2CJd8.publicNotes:
为了生长和传播，足够稳定的心能真菌菌落会派出采集者去收集养分。尽管大多数采集者带回的是腐烂的动植物残骸，但这种真菌最钟爱的猎物却是具有思维能力的生物，它们会将这些生物引诱回菌群，供菌落中的长老享用。

A menace to every sentient being, psychic fungi are an invasive species that propagate by using the minds of sapient creatures. Psychic fungi that have integrated a higher intelligence can become a regional or even planetary threat.

items.name: 菌丝网络
items.expectedDescription: Psychic fungi are connected to a network of psychic filaments bonding all psychic fungi from the same colony. This network grants the harvester the ability to detect creatures capable of thought within 30 feet of a bonded psychic fungus up to 1,000 feet away as an imprecise sense.
items.description: 心能真菌与来自同一菌落的所有心能真菌之间，通过一个由心灵菌丝构成的网络相互连接。这一网络赋予采集者一种模糊感官，使其能够探测到距离相互联结的心能真菌30尺以内、且距离自身最远可达1000尺的具有思维能力的生物。

items.name: 街机跳跃
items.expectedDescription: The hardlight mascot can make a special Leap up to 15 feet vertically and up to 20 feet horizontally without a check.
items.description: 实光吉祥物进行一次特殊的跳跃，无需检定垂直跳跃至多15尺和水平跳跃至多20尺。

v6Bo30Bsm9u4JBxo.name: 热熔巨兽聚合体
v6Bo30Bsm9u4JBxo.publicNotes:
在特定电磁环境下，两头或更多热熔巨兽可能将熔融核心喷射至同一岩浆腔室。这些融合物质将形成聚合体——一种体内流淌着星核金属脉络的强大生物。

Originally thought to be exiles from the Plane of Fire, thermatrods actually developed independently in multiple star systems in the Universe. A thermatrod resembles a molten bipedal creature, though they often walk on their front knuckles to support their heavy frames. Thermatrods sport distinctive raised dorsal plates that resemble hexagonal basalt columns, which researchers use to estimate an individual's age. A thermatrod's hardened exterior varies greatly based on local mineral deposits that make up a thermatrod's diet.

items.name: 温度感知
items.expectedDescription: A thermatrod caldera can detect nearby changes in temperature as a precise sense to detect living creatures and other heat sources.
items.description: 热熔巨兽能感知周围温度变化，以精确感官探测活体生物与其他热源。

items.name: 阳光感知
items.expectedDescription: A flarysca can sense the presence of sunlight within 60 feet as a precise sense.
items.description: 烁光尘能以精确感官感知60尺内的阳光。

vEA1FAanv0l7Yz4Z.name: 艾琳卓女王
vEA1FAanv0l7Yz4Z.publicNotes:
尽管无人证实艾琳卓女王的存在，但艾琳卓人与蚁弗米族间的少数相似之处，使学者们确信她们必然存在。事实上，正是这些强大的女族长，推动着艾琳卓人投身于乌库兰的恐噩的阵营。

The people known as elindrians vanished eons ago into desolate husk-hives beneath the surface of the planet Castrovel. Until recently, they were creatures of legend, existing only in the most obscure formian histories. Now, scholars on Castrovel desperately search for additional records about elindrians, their origins, and—most importantly—the truth about their connection to the terrifying ooze-like creature that recently descended from their moon, Elindrae. One theory is that elindrians share some primal bond with the ooze-thing called the Terror of Ukulam, and perhaps both originate from Elindrae—other theories claim that elindrians created the ooze in the first place or that they're distant cousins to formians, corrupted by the Terror long ago.

items.name: 呼召宇宙
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the void and call down a vertical column of dangerous cosmic material that rains destruction upon creatures in the area and shrouds the terrain around it in a swirl of stardust. This matter is made up of bits of burning stars and chunks of frozen comets, and it deals 5d12 cold damage and 5d12 fire damage to every creature in the area when you Cast the Spell. For the spell's duration, the cosmic material reduces visibility and mobility, making the area greater difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Heightened (10th) The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.
items.description:
你探入虚空并召来一片危险的宇宙物质，其在一个垂直圆柱内摧毁其中生物，并将地形化为星尘漩涡。这种物质由燃烧的恒星或冰冻的彗星组成，对施法时区域内的所有生物造成5d12火焰伤害和5d12寒冷伤害。在法术持续期间内，宇宙物质降低了能见度和机动性，使该区域内变为高等困难地形并且让该区域内或者透过其的所有事物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

升阶（10环）寒冷伤害和火焰伤害各增加2d12。

items.name: 播种奇点
items.expectedDescription:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

vjkOFdahK2Oic5cC.name: 异星卫士生物巨人
vjkOFdahK2Oic5cC.publicNotes:
生物巨人是忠诚的异星卫士，他们特意将自己的身体与植物和其他植被融合，以获得强大的力量。这种转变通常通过生物技术、魔法或基因实验完成，且不可逆转。无论采用何种方法，生物巨人都极其强壮，能够轻松击倒大多数人工屏障。异星卫士生物巨人通常是极端主义者，完全且充满热忱地致力于异星卫士的事业。

The Xenowardens are a powerful and well-respected organization who aim to safeguard and study the natural world and ensure that technological advances are ecologically responsible. With an incredibly diverse membership, their ranks include, among others, hermits who practice nature magic and eschew technology and scientists who create renewable energy from algae. On the other end of the spectrum are elite combat units like the Wildknights and the Greenguards and feared ecoterrorists like the enigmatic Oleander. The Xenowardens are led by a Greenspeaker, who's elected by acclaim and advised by their peers.

w0ttkMNgshJIBcDJ.name: 沙地蠕虫
w0ttkMNgshJIBcDJ.publicNotes:
沙地蠕虫是流散带蠕虫的变种，演化出在沙质或贫瘠小行星表面行动的能力。相应地，它们以敏捷换取了庞大体型，并能抵抗辐射。其电磁操控能力可作用于细小的铁磁性物质，使它们能心灵遥控沙子与小型金属碎片——既可作为武器投掷，也能当作伪装使用。

"Space worm" is a nonscientific term for a xenobiologically complex clade of invertebrate animals and beasts that make their home in the vastness of space. Some, like the diaspora and dust worms, show signs of intelligence and are directly related to each other. Others, like the surnoch, evolved separately, with their origins completely unknown to science.

The Free Captains have been a scourge of interstellar shipping across the Pact Worlds for generations, but since the adoption of Drift Lanes, the outlaws have expanded their reach and scale by targeting ships across the galaxy using the new standardized interstellar shipping routes.

items.description: 这种耐用而轻便的防护板有各种形状和大小，并且通常以定制的LED显示屏作为装饰，用以播放个人的徽记或某些组织的标志性颜色与符号。

items.name: 四臂
items.expectedDescription: You have four arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
