wuRiOirsQT17Ri5C.name: 幽噬怪
wuRiOirsQT17Ri5C.publicNotes:
大多数幽噬怪约8尺高，重400磅，翼展20尺。它们总是在移动，可能会在破碎的星舰或漂浮的地块上找到一个临时的巢穴，但很快又会离开，去寻找新的生物作为下一顿食物。虽然在物质宇宙中很少会遭遇幽噬怪，但如果它们的临时巢穴位于漂流域的出口处，这种情况还是有可能发生的。

The Drift is a strange place, and the creatures native to it are stranger still. Garaggakals prove no exception. Shaped vaguely like humanoids, they have arms and legs but also sallow, rubbery skin with long, scaly tails and gauzelike wings. Most horrifyingly, their faces are almost entirely taken up by their enormous, funnel-like mouth, lined with sharp teeth. While they use these mouths for the obvious purpose of biting, they can also use its powerful suction to draw actual life force from their prey.

Also known as "Drift wraiths," garaggakals hunt down any living creatures that linger too long in the Drift. For garaggakals, anything that isn't a fellow garaggakal is prey. However, they're no mere mindless hunters. Garaggakals are surprisingly intelligent and prefer to dissect victims, learning all about them before eating them. Often, garaggakals take their victims apart while they're still alive. Xenobiologists have determined that garaggakals don't even technically need to eat to survive, so their relentless hunger is seemingly psychological. They do require the energy of the Drift to survive in the absence of food, however, and further need the energy of the Drift to reproduce, seeking out areas of intense radiation to absorb and then build a new offspring from their own cells. Their children are fully grown at creation.

Garaggakals surprise their prey. They are quite stealthy and can even phase through solid matter, suddenly appearing on the inside of a starship—bad news for whatever living creatures happen to be inside. Con artists sell garaggakal repelling devices for travelers to use while in the Drift to prevent such visits.

items.name: 情绪感知
items.expectedDescription: The garaggakal senses all creatures that are under emotion effects as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: （情绪，心灵，异能） 幽噬怪能在所列范围内以模糊感官感知到所有受情绪效果影响的生物。

items.name: 感知思维
items.expectedDescription: The garaggakal's imprecise senses function through most materials and walls. The senses are blocked by energy fields (such as force fields and force effects) and sufficiently dense material: 10 feet of wood or plastic, 5 feet of stone, 1 foot of common metal, or 6 inches of lead or any starmetal.
items.description: 幽噬怪的模糊感官能穿透大多数材料和墙体生效。这些感官能被能量场（例如力场护盾和力场效果）以及足够致密的材料阻挡：10尺木材或塑料，5尺石头，1尺常见金属，或者6英寸厚的铅或任何星金。

x8PHZnkMCnpCWdMf.name: 生物科技卓越型战争机器
x8PHZnkMCnpCWdMf.publicNotes:
代号“尸花兽”的战争机器最早被记录于对乌尔里克卡氏族领地（Ulrikka Clanholdings）旗下的流散带矿业哨站发动的恐怖袭击中。当进入战斗状态时，“尸花兽”会展开为一团布满尖刺触须与猩红传感器的机械集群，能在数分钟内撕碎整支步兵小队。

The incursion began with a series of probes detected by anacites on Aballon. Strange machines with blazing sensors and articulated tentacles appeared out of nowhere, ripping through infrastructure seemingly at random and collecting intelligence all around Pact Worlds space. Panic spread fast, but since the machines always vanished without a trace, or exploded when captured, the sightings couldn't be confirmed or identified. Rumors began to circulate that the machines were a form of biotech never encountered before. Soon the Stewards became formally involved, shuttering the incidents behind the adamantine partition of top security clearance.

In Sarenith of 325 ag, after dozens of military operations failed to engage the elusive probes, a wing of fighters dispatched from the Idari finally got lucky and disabled one of the machines before it could self-destruct. Coaxed into giving up some of its secrets by top Pact Worlds scientists, the biotech vessel became the prototype for the "home grown" remote war machines that are currently being tested for use in combat. The replicas aren't alive but are built using robotic construction templates since the core of the original biotech design has proven too complicated to reverse engineer with Pact technology.

Remote war machines are proxies that can be controlled from a great distance. The original biotech war machines connect to the pilot's mind through a psychic link or unknown radio frequency. Robotic remote war machines connect to a computer via data link, allowing the pilot to control their proxy using a keyboard, virtual reality rig, or even a vidgame controller.

items.name: 星际通讯
items.expectedDescription: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.
items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

items.name: 热能隐影
items.expectedDescription: 10 feet. The war machine collects and reflects thermal energy to mask its presence. Any creatures targeting the war machine from outside the aura treats it as if it were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} unless they possess scent or a non-visual–based sense.
items.description: （灵光，幻术）10尺。该战争机器收集并反射热能以掩盖自身存在。任何从灵光范围外瞄准该战争机器的生物，除非拥有灵敏嗅觉或非视觉类感官能力，否则将其视为处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]状态。

items.name: 科技感知
items.expectedDescription: An assembly ooze can detect creatures and objects with the tech trait as a precise sense within the listed range.
items.description: 拾荒粘怪能在所列范围内以精确感官侦测到具有科技特征的生物和物体。

items.name: 拾荒外壳
items.expectedDescription: A scavenger slime builds a shell for itself from discarded pieces of technology and a secretion of natural resin. This grants the ooze Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to its Hardness but temporarily removes its immunity to critical hits. Once the scavenger slime is reduced to half its Hit Points or immediately after being damaged by a critical hit, the scavenger shell breaks, removing its Hardness and reducing its Armor Class to 22.
items.description: 拾荒粘怪利用废弃的科技碎片和天生的树脂分泌物为自己构筑外壳。这会赋予泥怪硬度。此硬度会减少其受到的伤害，数值等同于其硬度，但会临时移除泥怪的重击免疫。一旦拾荒粘怪降至一半生命值或受到重击伤害后，拾荒外壳会破损，移除其硬度并降低其护甲等级至22。

items.name: 拼接
items.expectedDescription: Scavenger slimes can repair any item with the tech trait without tools.
items.description: 拾荒粘怪能不使用工具修理任何具有科技特征的物体。

items.name: 回收武装
items.expectedDescription: A scavenger slime can incorporate up to three weapons into its protoplasmic body, gaining proficiency with each. These weapons are treated as integrated weapons and are powered by the scavenger slime's own technomagical nature without needing to reload.
items.description: 拾荒粘怪可以将至多3件武器融入其原生质躯体内，并能熟练操作每件武器。这些武器视作集成武器，且由拾荒粘怪自身的科技特性供能，而无需装填。

xbbJZjrTn2PET9Dk.name: 煞油刻法克虫
xbbJZjrTn2PET9Dk.publicNotes:
刻法克虫吞食煞油后，它们的身体会呈现出晶体般的外观，并成长为具有领地意识、贪婪凶残的威胁。

Khefak Biogenetics bioengineered khefaks to consume scrap thasteron so the waste could be refined into starship fuel. These creatures eventually became a prime example of a solution becoming a problem of its own. After the discovery of Drift travel, Akiton's thasteron market plummeted, removing the need for mining infrastructure, including khefaks. Khefak Biogenetics destroyed the production facilities, thinking they'd completely eradicated their creations. Khefaks are hardy, however, and the few survivors left the facilities. Beyond thasteron, they subsisted on inorganic materials, and their rapid reproduction rate allowed them to quickly spread all over Akiton. Some stowed away on starships, allowing them to spread throughout the Pact Worlds.

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你可以用大量的精神信息或神圣审判使一个生物的精神超负荷。心灵冲击会造成2d6心灵伤害。在重击时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 思维感知
items.expectedDescription: The plasma ooze can sense all non-mindless creatures within the listed range.
items.description: 等离子泥怪能在所列范围内感知到所有非无心智生物。

yBia55zJTW7IRPSR.name: 陨星魂火花
yBia55zJTW7IRPSR.publicNotes:
陨星魂火花呈现为一缕极其明亮的光芒，光芒中浮现出痛苦的面容。

When a solarian perishes while out of sync with the cycle of stars, their soul might become entangled with their solar mote. Extreme cosmic forces act on the soul as it attempts to reach the River of Souls, stretching it infinitely thin for all of eternity.

items.name: 引力倾斜
items.expectedDescription: A creature critically hit by a noquasar spark's graviton flare is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
items.description: 被陨星魂火花的引力子耀斑重击的生物会受击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。

yDAeGCMLkfSvSVpU.name: 实光故障体
yDAeGCMLkfSvSVpU.publicNotes:
这种实光生命体不稳定，显示出卡顿画面和异常动作。

Unlike normal holograms, hardlight life-forms are tangible, living entities.

yIDU4mt89O80nEjJ.name: 长须掠吼龙
yIDU4mt89O80nEjJ.publicNotes:
作为所有掠吼龙中最小的，长须掠吼龙已经适应了在茂密的丛林和森林中轻松移动，并融入到生机盎然的绿色植被中。长须掠吼龙下巴上长有类似胡须的触角，这些触角可以探测振动，使它们能够发现隐藏在茂密树叶中的猎物。当它们发现猎物时，掠吼龙会冲进战场，并用足够的力量撞向猎物，足以推倒树木或载具。偶尔，长须掠吼龙会成群生活和捕猎，以更好地保护自己免受更大的捕食者的侵害。

Renkrodas are a family of large dinosaur-like predators native to the planet Castrovel. They've spread beyond the jungle planet's boundaries thanks to smugglers, poachers, and ultra-wealthy big-game hunters. Bipedal and strong with long necks and decorative spines, renkrodas are best known for their terrifying roars, which they bellow frequently as a form of long-range communication and to scare away other predators and scavengers. Over a dozen species of renkrodas exist, each specially adapted to their environment or ecological niche.

items.name: 运动感知
items.expectedDescription: A whiskered renkroda can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 长须掠吼龙能在所列范围内以模糊感官通过空气或水中因生物移动产生的震动感知附近生物。

items.name: 森林穿行
items.expectedDescription: The whiskered renkroda ignores any difficult terrain caused by plants, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth.
items.description: 长须掠吼龙忽略任何由植物形成的困难地形，例如灌木，藤蔓和矮丛。

items.name: 电力感知
items.expectedDescription: An electrovore can sense electricity, including the electrical impulses found in most living creatures' nervous systems, as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 噬电兽能感知到电力，包括大多数活物神经系统中的电脉冲，这是一种指定范围内的模糊感官。

ydTI11Xclcf2dkNy.name: 侦察级渗透机器人
ydTI11Xclcf2dkNy.publicNotes:
侦察级渗透机器人并非一线战斗单位，其主要战术是悄无声息地潜入目标地点，利用催眠瓦斯炸弹使目标的守卫失去行动能力，进而获取其任务目标（如情报、物品等）。据协约世界的领导层透露，在静默战争（Silent War）期间，这类机器人还可能被用于执行更为隐秘和危险的任务：其反应伪装能力可助力它将致命爆炸物运送到舰船、造船厂以及其他军事设施，以实施破坏行动。

Brought to the forefront during the war against the Veskarium, and further perfected by various corporate interests within the Pact Worlds, infiltrator robots are known for being able to get into places where no one else could. Generally small and agile, infiltrator robots sneak into enemy territory and either download precious data or record incriminating evidence.

ykGzglKJlWdFCpHV.name: 流散带蠕虫长老
ykGzglKJlWdFCpHV.publicNotes:
存活数百年的流散带蠕虫，体型、力量与智力都会显著增长。它们主要守护自己的祖先家园，保护记载着生物电信息的珊瑚记录，并指挥年轻蠕虫的行动。

"Space worm" is a nonscientific term for a xenobiologically complex clade of invertebrate animals and beasts that make their home in the vastness of space. Some, like the diaspora and dust worms, show signs of intelligence and are directly related to each other. Others, like the surnoch, evolved separately, with their origins completely unknown to science.

items.name: 舌抓
items.expectedDescription: A creature hit by the diaspora worm's tongue becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike against AC 37 that deals at least 32 slashing damage. This prevents the worm from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes 1 day.
items.description: 被蠕虫舌打击命中的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]。生物可尝试一次针对AC 37的攻击，并且一次性至少造成32点挥砍伤害来切断其舌头。这会阻止蠕虫使用舌打击，直至其重新长出舌头（需1天）。

yr0WKPVvCVFQSx1T.name: 生物科技终极型战争机器
yr0WKPVvCVFQSx1T.publicNotes:
在所有曾遭遇代号"月光花"的生物科技恐怖造物并生还的理事军成员中，只有一人从长达数月的昏迷中苏醒后讲述了自己的经历。据她回忆，仅一台"月光花"战争机器就屠杀了利亚瓦拉月面S-117基地——那里曾是整个理事军深空望远镜阵列和行星防御炮台群的所在地。

The incursion began with a series of probes detected by anacites on Aballon. Strange machines with blazing sensors and articulated tentacles appeared out of nowhere, ripping through infrastructure seemingly at random and collecting intelligence all around Pact Worlds space. Panic spread fast, but since the machines always vanished without a trace, or exploded when captured, the sightings couldn't be confirmed or identified. Rumors began to circulate that the machines were a form of biotech never encountered before. Soon the Stewards became formally involved, shuttering the incidents behind the adamantine partition of top security clearance.

In Sarenith of 325 ag, after dozens of military operations failed to engage the elusive probes, a wing of fighters dispatched from the Idari finally got lucky and disabled one of the machines before it could self-destruct. Coaxed into giving up some of its secrets by top Pact Worlds scientists, the biotech vessel became the prototype for the "home grown" remote war machines that are currently being tested for use in combat. The replicas aren't alive but are built using robotic construction templates since the core of the original biotech design has proven too complicated to reverse engineer with Pact technology.

Remote war machines are proxies that can be controlled from a great distance. The original biotech war machines connect to the pilot's mind through a psychic link or unknown radio frequency. Robotic remote war machines connect to a computer via data link, allowing the pilot to control their proxy using a keyboard, virtual reality rig, or even a vidgame controller.

items.name: 持续脉冲雷达
items.expectedDescription: The war machine can detect all creatures and objects within 100 feet of itself, treating hidden, invisible, and unobserved creatures as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
items.description: 该战争机器可探测自身周围100尺范围内的所有生物与物体，将藏匿、隐形及无踪状态的生物全部视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]状态。

items.name: 星际通讯
items.expectedDescription: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.
items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

zmM9D97ulPMgdUd1.name: 蜥掠蛸
zmM9D97ulPMgdUd1.publicNotes:
蜥掠蛸一种爬行类怪物，拥有强悍的意志，剃刀般锋利的牙齿，以及在一大团用于行走的触手上方退化的翅膀。

Skreesires, and their offspring skreelings, are vicious predators who skulk and prowl in the crags and caverns of the cosmos.
